programme.desc: 尚書之女沈沅芷為戀人定罪，被迫嫁入侯府受盡樊星序報復。二人揭露顧恆遠陰謀後，又卷入叛國事件。兩人將計就計達成合作，在相處中消除誤會情愫漸生，誅殺叛徒，有情人終成眷屬.(n)

programme.title: 橘祥如意
programme.desc: 講述了世代經營橘子產業的沈家老爺沈晏清與六弟沈晏洲同時愛上家境困頓的秀橘，為了延續沈家的香火，在大太太莊惠的安排下秀橘嫁給了沈晏清，於是四人之間開啟了一段愛恨痴纏的虐戀故事.(n)

programme.title: 非來不可
programme.sub-title: 非震式旅行團體驗新潮運動
programme.desc: 邀請了兩位博學幽默的大叔孟非、劉震雲老友相聚，攜手“忘年交”新朋友張顏齊、李雅娟，展開代際碰撞的「交換遊學」，互相體驗對方的旅行玩法，他們將依次去往呼倫貝爾、成都、南京、昆山、大理等地，邀非見不可之人，去非來不可之地.(n)

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識.(n)

programme.title: 大使的廚房
programme.desc: 由李晨、吳尊、何超蓮、劉維作常駐嘉賓，帶領觀眾走進阿根廷、新西蘭、泰國、冰島、土耳其、愛爾蘭等國家駐華大使館，探秘各地文化密碼，復刻地道異國風味，並結合中國特色美食文化打造中外融合料理，開啟以食會友、賓至如歸的文化交流真人秀.(n)

programme.title: 偏愛之戀
programme.sub-title: 島外約會爭奪戰高能開啟
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛.(n)

programme.title: 罪嫁
programme.desc: 尚書之女沈沅芷為戀人定罪，被迫嫁入侯府受盡樊星序報復。二人揭露顧恆遠陰謀後，又卷入叛國事件。兩人將計就計達成合作，在相處中消除誤會情愫漸生，誅殺叛徒，有情人終成眷屬.(n)

programme.title: 橘祥如意
programme.desc: 講述了世代經營橘子產業的沈家老爺沈晏清與六弟沈晏洲同時愛上家境困頓的秀橘，為了延續沈家的香火，在大太太莊惠的安排下秀橘嫁給了沈晏清，於是四人之間開啟了一段愛恨痴纏的虐戀故事.(n)

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.(n)

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.sub-title: 探討原生家庭對愛情觀帶來的影響
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.(n)

programme.title: 有秘密的我們 第2季
programme.sub-title: 一女兩男約會暗流湧動
programme.desc: 以山野為背景，10位素人嘉賓都攜帶一個秘密進入「真相小屋」，這些秘密可能涉及過去的傷痛、未了的心願等，隨著節目推進逐漸揭曉；秘密成為推動他們情感發展的關鍵因素，也增加了未知性和驚喜感，並放棄了傳統戀綜依賴觀察室嘉賓或專家解析的模式，讓觀眾直接充當觀察者.(n)

programme.desc: Millionaire Thornton Melon’s (Rodney Dangerfield) son is a college misfit, so Thornton lends some fatherly support...by enrolling as a fellow freshman! Who cares if he never finished high school? Thornton’s pockets are deep enough to buy his way in! But when he steals his professor’s girlfriend (Sally Kellerman), Thornton goes just a little too far. Now, he’ll have to hit the books, instead of his bank account – or go back to being the world’s wealthiest dropout.(n)

programme.title: 愛情萬歲
programme.desc: Ching and Sung work in “Love Cafe” in the dazzling Soho and the main job is to cure broken hearts. But happiness won't last forever. After gathering with schoolmates, where Ching's ex-boyfriend Hung showed up, depute between Ching and Sung breaks out and their plan to study in Beijing almost vanishes... Joe met Kelly in a disco and falls into her in the first sight. However, Kelly is in fact a weapon of Joe's ex-girlfriend for revenge. But the more Kelly knows about Joe, the less she can pull herself out of the relationship... Yu has a handsome and career type boyfriend who will buy her everything. But what she needs is care which can't be bought. Sing, having a crush on Yu, always stands by her and comforts her desperate heart. But their 6-year age difference seems a gap that Yu couldn't step forward.

programme.title: 封神第一部
programme.desc: Long ago, the mystic sages in Kunlun saw that humankind had descended into chaos. A King consumed by his lust for power and aided by evil beings threatened the mortal world. One Immortal was willing to sacrifice his immortality to try and save mankind. Beguiled by a beautiful Fox Demon, there is nothing that can stop the ambitious King Zhou and his band of loyal disciples. The King unleashes a brutal campaign upon the land, and forces the lords of all the other realms to deliver their sons to him as wards. Loyalty to the King is tested against loyalty to family as sons are forced to murder their fathers. Black magic aids the King, but the heavens are on the side of the hero! Can the heavens possibly save mankind? Which will prevail, power or peace..

programme.title: 送院途中
programme.desc: After being reassigned to a new station along with his superior, Rock Sir, paramedic Wong Wai is assigned to ride with Jerry Ma. At first, Wai is worried that his work performance review would be affected because he doesn't agree with Jerry's way of working. But after some time, Jerry influences Wai to remember once again that the aim of paramedic work is to save every victim. Meanwhile, Jerry, a single father, is hesitating over the future of his daughter, Bonnie. He can't bear to see her leave, but he finally decides to send Bonnie to Canada for schooling. Before she leaves, she tells Jerry that she's worried about being forgotten when she's in Canada, just like her late mother was forgotten. Jerry tries to explain himself, but it's hard to digest such long-gestating grief. At the same time, a serious traffic accident occurs on Tuen Mun highway. Jerry immediately rushes to the scene for the rescue effort. When Wai notices that Rock Sir cares more about taking over command t.

programme.title: 大事件
programme.desc: A TV news unit live broadcasts the embarrassing defeat of a police battalion by five bank robbers. Later, Inspector Rebecca decides to turn the stakeout into a breaking news show.

programme.title: 緊急迫降
programme.desc: Veteran chief police detective In-ho (SONG Kang-ho) receives a tip about a man threatening a terrorist attack against a plane. While investigating, he discovers that the suspect has actually boarded flight no. KI501. Despite his phobia of flying, Jae-hyuk (LEE Byung-hun) decides to go to Hawaii for the sake for his daughter's health. At the airport, he is distracted by a strange man who hangs around, speaking to them in a menacing way. Flight no. KI501 departs Incheon Airport for Hawaii, but soon afterwards a man dies for mysterious reasons. Fear and chaos spread quickly, not only inside the plane, but also on land. Hearing this news, Transport Minister Sook-hee (JEON Do-yeon) sets up a counterterrorism task force and calls an emergency meeting in order to find a way to land the airplane.

programme.title: 大追捕
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong celebrity is found brutally murdered, detective Lam is called in to take charge. But the more that Lam pursues his suspect, the deeper he falls into a web of lies.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -打開世外大門
programme.desc: “Another World”, the Hong Kong animation nominated for the Annecy International Animation Film Festival (also known as the Oscars of animation), is a heartfelt seven-year labour of love. In this interview, its screenwriter-producer Polly Yeung and Art director Step C. share the behind-the-scenes stories. Polly recounts her moment of tears on the nomination and the intention of its theme and character design. Step C. also reveals their feeling of frustrations like giving-up that comes along with the challenges of completing this project.

programme.title: LAST MILE：全面引爆
programme.desc: On the day before the Black Friday sale, a box delivered by a global e-commerce company, explodes. The box was sent from one of the biggest warehouses, which has the three-quarter logistic shares around Tokyo. It leads a series of mysterious bombings that terrorize whole of Japan. Elena Funado, who was just appointed as a new director of the warehouse, is forced to control this unprecedented situation with a line manager, Ko Nashimoto. Who planted the bombs? For what purpose? How many bombs are left? - And where are they now? In this modern society, distribution service becomes critical need for our lives and that cannot be stopped. Can Elena and Ko end the serial bombings without stopping blood flowed in “blood vessel”; the global logistics system like a web.

programme.title: 寒戰
programme.desc: Approaching midnight in Hong Kong, police headquarters receives an anonymous call: a police van carrying the advanced equipment and five officers has disappeared off the grid..

programme.title: 武替道
programme.desc: LEE Sam was the undisputed king of stunt choreography during the golden era of Hong Kong action cinema in the 80s. After a devastating stunt accident, Sam steps away from the industry for 30 years. However, his old friend, a veteran director, has now persuaded Sam to work as the stunt choreographer on what will be the director's last film. The only catch is that his film stars Wai - Sam's former stunt crew member who has since become a famous action star in his own right. Sam and Wai have a contentious history, with Sam's infamously overbearing and demanding personality clashing with Wai's own ego and ambition. By chance, Sam crosses paths with a young, ambitious stuntman named LEE Sai Long, who sees this as an opportunity to advance his career. Long is caught between Sam and his former protege turned rival. At the same time, Long helps Sam to reconcile with his estranged daughter, Cherry. As Sam returns to the world he once dominated, he must confront his past, mend fences w.

programme.title: 忠烈楊家將
programme.desc: The plot places focus on how the seven sons of the Yang family held hands in the rescue of their father. During a series of battles in a place called Jinsha, they pitted the few against the Khitans. Despite in great peril, they never lose faith or gave up their mission to save their father..

programme.title: 百年好合
programme.desc: Millionaire Tiger Hung (Louis Koo) is told to find cure at the mysterious all-women martial arts sect Omei, and there he meets Omei's young master May (Sammi Cheng). The healing process moves smoothly until May's big sister Misery (Li Bing-Bing) shows up and challenges May into a duel. Misery has lost her mind and she threatens to destroy Omei unless May beats her with the sect's long-lost'Heartbreak Sword Technique'..

programme.title: 臥底女神團
programme.desc: Shih Tzu is a tough journalist; despite, being a tiny lady with 155cm height. All her life, she's been teased about being so tiny. So, she determines to have a tall boyfriend and when she gets married, she can have tall children. She even wishes to name her baby “Giraffe.” As soon as she meets Faifa, the tallest senior in her university, who becomes a dedicated and hardworking Police Officer, she determines to win his heart. Would she be able to excel in her career and make him fall in love with her.

programme.title: 危樓深淵
programme.desc: An ordinary office worker Dong-won (KIM Sung-kyun) and his family move into a house he bought after years of saving. Overwhelmed with happiness, he invites his colleagues to a housewarming party, but heavy overnight rain leads to a gigantic sinkhole, and in a mere minute, it swallows up the entire apartment and the people inside. Hundreds of meters down the hole, Dong-won, his neighbor Man-su (CHA Seoung-won), and the unfortunate housewarming party guests must find their way out. Rain starts to pour down, filling the sinkhole with water, giving them very little time to get back to the surface.

programme.title: 飯戲攻心
programme.desc: It is often said that food and meals bring families together, but in TABLE FOR SIX it's clear that not all family gatherings are a cause for celebration. In this melodramatic comedy, three brothers reside in a home that they inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother Steve (Dayo Wong), theoretically is the man of the house, but he constantly is getting dissed by his two younger brothers Bernard (Louis Cheung Kai Chung) and Lung (Chan Charm Man Peter) for the decisions he makes, the inedible meals that he cooks, and his complicated romantic encounters. To prepare for a family reunion dinner, Steve seeks the help of Lung's girlfriend and foodie Josephine (Ivana Wong) and in doing so, wins back their hearts for a while, until his old flame and Bernard's new girlfriend Monica (Stephy Tang) shows up. That's a recipe for a disaster waiting to explode! The unexpected visit of Steve's part-time girlfriend Meow (Lin Min-Chen) not only fails to turn down the heat and cool th.

programme.title: 聽見兩個世界
programme.desc: Dai is born to deaf parents and has been raised with deep love in rural Japan. However, as he grows older, he becomes troubled by his differences from others and begins to blame his deaf mother for his daily frustrations. When he turns 20, Dai leaves home for Tokyo as if to escape. Life in Tokyo was lonely at first, but when Dai starts working as a magazine reporter, he finds fulfillment in meeting a diverse group of people. Time eventually passes, and Dai returns home for the first time in eight years. In spending peaceful time with his deaf mother after a long time, a memory that has been sealed away unexpectedly comes back to Dai.

programme.title: 烏托邦浩劫
programme.desc: The world has been reduced to rubble by a massive earthquake.While no one knows for sure how far the ruins stretch, or what the cause of the earthquake may be, in the heart of Seoul there is only one apartment building left standing. It is called Hwang Gung Apartments. As time passes, outsiders start coming in to Hwang Gung Apartments trying to escape the extreme cold. Before long, the apartment residents are unable to cope with the increasing numbers. Feeling a threat to their very survival, the residents enact a special measure.

programme.title: 長安三萬里
programme.desc: A few years after the outbreak of the Anshi Rebellion, the Tubo army attacked the southwest. Gao Shi, who was trapped in the isolated city, recalled his life with Li Bai to the eunuch of the supervising army.

programme.title: 殺人預言
programme.desc: One day, the dead body of Min-tae only brother Seok-tae was found, and Seok-tae ‘s wife Moon-young has disappeared. While searching for clues on this brother's death, Min-tae found that a novelist Ho-ryung also following the same trail and he discovered that the death of his brother was predicted in Ho-ryung's bestselling novel, ‘Nocturnal.' Min-tae was thrown into confusion and brother's gang and police also getting involved in the case. To find out the truth behind brother's death, Min-tae began a relentless and furious pursuit..

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....

programme.title: 竊聽風雲3
programme.desc: Five Years ago, LAW was jailed for killing a major land owner in a car accident. At that time LAW worked as a chauffeur for the rural tycoon LUK. It was rumored that LUK was behind such land owner's death, which gave LUK a competitive edge in the native apartment development deal. Before the Hong Kong handover in 1997, every native, male resident in the New Territories was granted the right to build a house. Yet it had caused social unrest over the land right, until recently the government decided to gather all of the remaining land rights from these residents and plan to build taller apartment buildings. LUK wished to swallow the enormous project and this started the fights between LUK, the land owner and other real estate developers. When LAW gets out of prison five years later, the world has changed..

programme.title: 寒戰2
programme.desc: The story of this highly-anticipated sequel continues as Acting Police Commissioner Sean Lau (Aaron Kwok) is promoted to the highest rank in the police force. Joe (Eddie Peng Yuyan), son of Deputy Police Commissioner Waise Lee (Tony Leung Ka Fai) who is behind the conspiracy, is taken into custody and Waise is forced to retire. But Master, Themind remains unknown, until the resurface of a former police chief who unveils an unprecedented scheme to corrupt the police force. Things get more complicated when senior counsel Oswald Kan (Chow Yun Fat) leads an impeachment proceeding against Sean. Oswald's every decision is pivotal in determining who stays on top of the game.

programme.title: 誠實選舉媽 2
programme.desc: After failing to win the Seoul mayoral election, Joo Sang-sook became an unemployable property and no parties will admit to associating with her in fear of bad press, but when she rescues a young man from drowning, she is suddenly pulled into spotlight and wins the election to become the Gangwon province governor. But her honesty sinks her approval rating and she resorts back to lying through her teeth. As fate would have it, her truth mouth returns! Not only that, her chief of staff Hee-cheol is cursed with the same truth bomb.

Smash-head is a CID officer. Wracked by insecurity he believes the world will be destroyed by pollution. That's why he's an environmentalist. Carmen is a child psychologist. She specializes in hypnotism, her world is full of grace and vitality. That's why she believes in love. The two meet during a police chase. When Smash-head kills a hostage he mistakes as a kidnapper, he is put under internal investigation. And his superior tries to drag him into a corrupt syndicate. With no way out, he turns to Carmen. Under hypnotism, he remembers his long forgotten past and the image he had of himself as a young and enthusiastic fighter for justice. Holding on to this memory and the love of Carmen, he takes his pistol, number 9413..

programme.title: 極速快遞
programme.desc: “I deliver everything that the post office service does not handle.” Eun-ha, who is a normal junkyard employee, secretly works as a delivery clerk that deals with unusual delivery request. One day, Eun-ha heads to Seoul to pick up a client who is involved in a gambling crime that wants to flee overseas. However, Eun-ha meets the client's young son at the pick-up point, instead of the client himself. Kyung-pil, a current police officer who is actually masterminding the whole gambling crime, chases after the missing child who has the security key to the bank account that holds 30 million dollars. After a long pursuit from Seoul to Busan, Eun-ha fights against the police to protect the child.

programme.title: 中國合伙人
programme.desc: 80's. 3 undergraduates share a common ambition - to live the American dream. They establish a tutorial school New Vision, yet the sudden fame are tearing their friendship apart..

programme.title: 12.12：首爾之春
programme.desc: After the assassination of President Park, martial law has been declared. A coup d'etat bursts out by Defense Security Commander CHUN Doo-gwang and a private band of officers following him. Capital Defense Commander LEE Tae-shin, an obstinate soldier who believes the military should not take political actions, fights against CHUN Doo-gwang to stop him. The conflict between the two grows while military leaders are holding their decision and Defense Minister is gone. In the midst of chaos, the spring of Seoul that everyone longed for heads to unexpected direction.

programme.title: 飯戲攻心2
programme.desc: Belief in our own blessings can bring us good fortune, but what is true fortune? Fortune and misfortune, love and hate, what is their ultimate definitions? One family, three couples, three weddings. After they decided to move on, what further challenges await them? Marriage isn't just about two individuals; it involves a whole family of aunts, uncles, and cousins. Sunny Chan, with his unique sense of humor, once again dives into the complex dynamics of modern society's men and women, families and romance.

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：任達華: 燈火闌珊
programme.desc: Widow Mei-heung has gone through countless sleepless nights since the death of her husband, Bill. One day, she finds a key among the items that Bill left behind, leading her to his secret neon workshop and his young apprentice, Leo. She learns from Leo that Bill had an unfulfilled last wish–to recreate a demolished legendary neon sign. With Leo's help, Mei-heung tries to uncover the story behind the sign and learns the craft of blowing neon lights in hopes of fulfilling her deceased husband's last wish with her own hands. Along the way, Mei-heung reminisces about her beautiful encounters with Bill and unearths pieces of Bill's past as if they are the last consolation left by him. Meanwhile, Mei-heung's daughter, Prism, plans to leave Hong Kong with her fiance, but she is unable to break the news to Mei-heung. As clues of the legendary neon sign gradually emerge, the secrets that Mei-heung couldn't face are about to be revealed..

programme.title: 反詐師奶兵團
programme.desc: The scammer who scammed my money asked for help! Duk-hee, an energetic woman looking into various loans due to a laundry fire, receives a call from a bank clerk named Son offering a reasonable loan. Sending money to Son who demanded various fee for the loan, she later realizes that the entire process was a voice phishing scam, leaving her in shock. Having lost her entire fortune and forced to live on the streets with her children, Duk-hee receives another call from Son one day... This time, it's a plea for help! Determined to rescue the scammer and recover her lost money, Duk-hee equips herself with various skills and, along with her colleagues, who are equally determined, to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: 堅如磐石
programme.desc: Su Jianming, the son of Deputy Mayor Zheng Gang of Jinjiang City, defies his father's counsel and attends a cunning dinner invitation from the wealthiest man in Jinjiang City, Li Zhitian. To his astonishment, he becomes an unwilling witness to a shocking incident where someone is coerced into thrusting their hand into a simmering hotpot. As past mysteries resurface, hidden factions from various quarters plot and scheme, employing intricate strategies, scrutiny, and suspicion. Amidst the web of conflicting desires, the pressing question remains: who will ultimately unveil the final mask.

programme.title: 新宿事件
programme.desc: The foreign migrant communities in Tokyo live shadowy lives. The Japanese neither acknowledge nor welcome them. They are shunned by the mainstream society, hounded by the yakuza, and go about their days under fear of being discovered and repatriated. It is an alien world for Steelhead – an honest, hardworking tractor repairman. Steelhead had decided to take the perilous journey to Tokyo after he lost contact with his girlfriend, who had arrived in the city earlier.

programme.title: 臨時劫案
programme.desc: Two perplexed middle-aged losers, Robby and Fai are good friends. Fai is honest man. His wife left him with an elderly home business. Fai has tried very hard to keep it running until the owner increases the rent crustily. Taxi driver Robby, who is timid and unreliable, he always neglected the conflicts between his mother and his wife. Robby always lives paycheck to paycheck without a financial plan, so he is at a loss what to do. There are two robberies involving the money exchange stores just across the street encourages Robby and Fai to get a gun and rob the same. It is a destiny to meet the ruthless bandit Mui, who acts wicked, scheming and chivalrous.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 小心眼
programme.desc: Zhang Liang is a young man who does not engage into any proper work. His secret hobby is to play with all kinds of high-tech candid technology, especially the candid photographs. He likes to upload the photographs on the Internet to share his homepage with others. Within his beloved masterpiece, he specially falls madly in love on a young air-stewardess. One day, Zhang Liang follows the young lady Amy from the airport to Tai O. In order to catch more splendid segments, Liang brings his full equipment all the way to stay in a vacation house - Mei King Village and becomes a neighbour of Amy..

programme.title: 成功補習班
programme.desc: The year is 1994. As the life-changing college examination looms on the horizon for Heng and his two best friends, they spend their days pulling pranks at their cram school, obsessing over sex and stressing over their uncertain futures. However, the cram school's new tutor, Teacher Chih, manages to tame the wild trio and helps them discover their true selves.

programme.title: 困獸
programme.desc: The President of Gaming Association blacklisted Wa Sam Group from bidding of gaming concessions on the ground. This blacklisting triggered a series of retaliations from Wa Sam Group. Thus, the Anti-Triad Office immediately set up a special team lead by Lee Shui Ming and he called back Man Fung for help. Fourth Elder's wife Chu Lei received a phone call from her ex-boyfriend Man Fung for a meeting. Kwan Chit, a member of the Gaming Association with the support of Wa Sam Group, also persuaded Man Fung to stop keeping his eyes on them. The two have parted in discord. Kwan Chit remembered the tragic death of his ex-girlfriend Man Kei, sister of Man Fung. He came to Man Fung late at night, the two old friends finally agreed to revenge for their beloved one together.

programme.title: 鬼馬狂想曲
programme.desc: In Hong Kong 1969, private investigation agency boss Man is investigating an extra marital case. With his two employees, the smart looking idiot Kit and the Hong Kong Columbia Radio Night School graduate Pufferfish, he follows the target Lascar Row. The trio stumbles into an antique shop and breaks many antiques in the store. The cheap Man force Kit and Pufferfish to take responsibility. Kit wisely makes Pufferfish take sole responsibility. The dumb Pufferfish helpless buys the pile of shattered antiques with his own money. In the pieces he finds a broken magic lamp..

programme.title: 浪漫特攻隊
programme.desc: Yeo-rae is a retired national superstar in Korea. During her holiday on a South Pacific Island, she gets married to Jonathan, a tycoon who she initially thought of as her prince charming but turns out to be a control freak. With the help of her neighbour Beom-wu, who happens to be a die-hard fan of Yeo-rae, she is going to get herself out of the cage with a murder plan.

programme.title: 當男人戀愛時
programme.desc: A-cheng is a rogue who relies on debt collection for living. He lives in the attic of a small barber shop managed by his elder brother. It's time for a 37-year-old adult to live on his own, but he always ignores all contempt from others. One day, he goes to the hospital to collect a debt from a creditor in coma, there he meets Hao-ting, daughter of the creditor. She is forced to sign a debt transferring contract without any complaint. Her silhouette of silently taking care of her father deeply attracts A-cheng, a guy who never had responsibility before. A-cheng clumsily draws a “graffiti contract” to offset Hao-ting's debts with walks and dinners as dating, even tries his best to manage the funeral for her father. Hao-ting feels touched by his behaviors and accepts his pursuit. Unexpectedly, a barter gambling takes away their future ruthlessly. A-cheng is not only imprisoned, also diagnosed with hemangioma. He has not much time left...At that moment, A-cheng finally understan.

programme.title: 老豆死開一陣先
programme.desc: Angst-ridden college student, Nanase Nobata (Suzu Hirose), lives with her father, Hakaru, president of the Nobata Pharmaceutical Company, resentful of his constant nagging about her life, and for being so absorbed in his work. While developing a revolutionary 'reverse aging' drug, Hakaru's team discovered a drug that causes temporary death, followed by full recovery in 2 days. Hakaru had been persuaded to take the drug in an attempt to expose a corporate spy planted in his company by a rival firm looking to merge with Nobata and capitalize on the anti-aging formula. When Hakaru drops dead, it sets the company in an uproar as his will names Nanase as the new president. She soon learns the truth about her father's condition and the spy from Matsuoka (Ryo Yoshizawa), a young employee in the company. Together with Matsuoka and the actual ghost of Hakaru, Nanase endeavors to prevent her father's enemies from prematurely cremating his body before the drug can wear off and allow him.

programme.title: 這個阿爸真爆炸
programme.desc: Ying is a single parent who's having a tough time disciplining his wild teenage daughter Ellen. When Ying is mistaken to be the famous gangster hero 'Shadowless Eagle', he gains both recognition and popularity among Ellen's gangster classmates, and she begins to gain new respect for her father. But Ying's legend becomes more than he can handle when some real triad members come seeking revenge.

programme.title: 新次元！蠟筆小新大電影：超能力大決戰～飛吧飛吧手捲壽司～
programme.desc: 40-years ago, there was a prophecy claiming that in the year of “20” and “23”, two emitting lights would come to the Earth from outer space. And the dark light with strong power will bring out a huge disaster. In the summer of 2023, as predicted, two mysterious lights approach Japan and descend on Kasukabe. The white light hits Shin-chan, which makes him get a superpower. Meanwhile, a man called Mitsuru Hiriya, has been bathed in dark light and has acquired psychic powers begins to run amok. A man who wants the destruction of the world, Hiriya VS A happy-go-lucky kindergarten child, Shinnosuke. A superpower battle is going to begin.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 扮工女團補英班
programme.desc: In mid ‘90s when sexual and academic discriminations were rampant, 3 young female office workers, Ja-young, Yu-nah, Bo-ram, are shunned by their company and are only given insignificant chores due to the fact that they only have high school diplomas. When a company-wide memo goes around announcing that obtaining 600 score in TOEIC could earn them a promotion, the trio and other high school grad female office workers enroll in English classes in hope of thought of finally advancing their careers. One day, Ja-young is sent to a factory in the country on an errand and by chance witnesses its waste water being poured into the river. She's convinced that the company is into shady dealings, and together with her 2 friends, they go on a hunt to find irrefutable evidence but they're on the verge of getting fired by the company trying to cover up the corruption. When the rumor of the trio's renegade action goes around, they are completely shunned by everyone there. But the female wor.

programme.title: 蘋果咬一口
programme.desc: Miss Sung has come to Hong Kong to be a teacher, and hopefully moonlight as a model. On the Internet, she starts to talk with 'Blue Moon', a photographer. While attempting to shoot, the two have an argument, and Sung seems to lose her chance at being a model, until a second consideration by Jet leads to a completed shoot. Love between the two begins to bloom, but Jet's stepsister, who is also one of Miss Sung's students, starts to interfere, and may just ruin everything.

programme.title: 超異能特攻
programme.desc: The five ordinary people, who developed their superpowers after receiving organ transplants from a previously superpowered being, fighting against another psychic, who also gained the power through transplant and covets their powers.

programme.title: 王的盛宴
programme.desc: The early history of a nation unfolds through the actions of three heroes – Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Han Xin – who chased their dreams of uniting a warring nation and fought through major milestones of the Chu-Han Contention years in the third century. From the Julu War to the Hongmen Banquet, the Gaixia War to the death of HanXin, the narration of Liu Bang – who would be the founding emperor of the new Han Dynasty – sets the stage for a tale of betrayal and brothers at war, where the last man standing inherits a nation.

programme.title: 第一誡
programme.desc: Every day, the Police Force receives 185 phone calls.180 of them are about burglaries, murders, rapes and kidnappings. The remaining 5 begin with: “There is something strange in my house, can you please send someone over to take a look?” For rookie Sergeant Lee, being a cop means running down crooks and upholding the law. Injured in a shoot-out, he finds out to his horror that he is reassigned to the dubious-sounding Miscellaneous Affairs Department (MAD)..

programme.title: 12金鴨
programme.desc: Devastated by a love affair, former in-demand gigolo Future Chang retreats to Thailand. Thanks to the intervention of his high school teacher, Future summons the courage to return..

programme.title: 鬼同你住
programme.desc: Three bizarre tales intertwine in this horror satire set against the housing crisis of Hong Kong, in which the soaring property prices have driven dwellers to take every insane effort necessary to secure a cramped space, even if it means sharing the same roof with the dead.

programme.title: 在我和天空之間
programme.desc: Naomi works for a small publishing company in the suburbs. After the sudden death of parents, she and her cat move into a towering building arranged by her uncle. But the sense of loss still makes her feel unreal. One day, she meets star actor Morinori..

programme.title: 金剛王：死亡救贖
programme.desc: When he was 8-years-old, Vajrasattva was among the children sold to the Temple of Hades. Forced by his captors to fight for food, he accidentally caused the death of his brother. He made a secret oath to take revenge. Many years pass and, as an adult, Vajrasattvah is the greatest assassin in the Temple. He escapes to China and joins the Southern Shaolin Temple where he receives spiritual enlightenment and vows to protect his own country against the Japanese. Meanwhile, the Temple of Hades have set up a branch in China. It hosts daily fight competitions, openly challenging Chinese fighters. Many Chinese warriors, including prisoners-of-war from various nations, are killed in the arena and photographic evidence spread across the country as propaganda to crush the Chinese spirit. The Temple of Hades begins buying children again, training them to become assassins against their fellow Chinese.To rescue the children, Vajrasattva enters the Temple and challenges their fiercest Hade.

programme.title: 超級無敵羊咩咩大電影之天外飛咩
programme.desc: When a visitor from beyond the stars – an impish and adorable alien called LU-LA – crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun soon sees an opportunity for alien-powered fun and adventure, and sets off on a mission to shepherd LU-LA back to her home... Little do the pair know, though, that they are being pursued at every turn by a mysterious alien-hunting government agency, spearheaded by the formidable Agent Red and her bunch of hapless, hazmat-suited goons. Can Shaun and the flock avert Farmageddon on Mossy Bottom Farm before it's too late.

credits.director: 李察菲蘭, 威爾比察

programme.title: 我的婆婆黃飛鴻
programme.desc: Gucci, an ordinary teenage girl grows up in a single-parent family. In order to protect her good friend, she fights with somebody and is sent to girls' home. After release, she knows her mother died in a car accident. So she doesn't have a choice but to live with her weird grandmother, Wong Fei Hung. Gucci does not like Wong's old-fashion and strange character and they always quarrel about some unimportant issues. Gucci has fallen in love with a bartender. However, happy times always can't last, bad luck seems still follow Gucci.....

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -逃出大風鎮
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.

programme.title: 你好，之華
programme.desc: There are fidgety encounters, like there are uncomplicated goodbyes. All Yuan Zhinan left behind on the morning of her departure from the world was a letter and an invitation to a school reunion. Attending the reunion in lieu of her late elder sister, Zhihua accidentally ran into Yin Chuan, her crush of her youth. As old memories are evoked to a present time of reshuffled relationships, as correspondences travel through different contexts and times, Zhihua slowly uncovers the intricate story among the trio.

programme.title: 真假佈局
programme.desc: Min-ho's adulterous lover Se-hee is murdered in the hotel where the two of them spent time together. Apart from Min-ho, there is no trace of anyone else having been there. Immediately singled out as the prime suspect, Min-ho maintains his innocence, and he hires the lawyer Shin-ae, who has a 100% record of victory in court, to defend him. In order to prove his innocence, she asks Min-ho to confess to her the entire truth. He admits that a car accident that they were in the day before the murder may be connected in some way to Se-hee's death.

programme.title: 男歌女唱
programme.desc: Chu Wai Tak is a natural born introvert, a white collar worker who suffers from a serious lack of self confidence. Her greatest achievement at work is 'using 10% less toilet paper than yesterday' and saving several more cents. King's self confidence is at its peak as he has crowned himself the King of Karaoke. He becomes exhausted if he does not go to the karaoke box and sing for a few days. King loves to gain attention at the company and has indeed brought a lot of energy to a boring company.

programme.title: 七月與安生
programme.desc: Qiyue and Ansheng are two high school best friends. Qiyue is calm like water while Ansheng is a fiery ball of passion. As fate would have it, they fall in love with the same man, Jia-ming. Because of their different values and lifestyles, they are destined to arrive at two completely different endings..

programme.title: 隔牆有愛
programme.desc: Flirting with a wall between them! Seung-jin wants to become a singer, so he's preparing for a TV audition program. It's his first night at his new place. He suddenly hears a woman's ghostly wails! It turns out that Seung-jin's next door neighbor, Ra-ni has been driving people away from this apartment because of the super-thin walls! But Seung-jin won't go without a fight! After a battle of loud noises, they decide to take turns being noisy. They don't know each other's names or faces. But as they share their lives, they start to develop strange feelings for each other... The thin walls force them to share everything with each other. It's a brand new kind of romance.

programme.title: 決戰中女社: 千機變
programme.desc: Ace Vampire slayer Reeve and his new partner Gipsy are on this mission, however Reeve's younger sister Helen falls in love with the Vampire fifth prince Kazaf.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 某日某月
programme.desc: In 1992, a heavy rainstorm caused massive power outage in Hong Kong. At that night, two young astrology enthusiasts, Moon and Sun, met under the starry night by the seaside. When their affection to each other grew, Sun was admitted into a boarding school and would move to another country in a few months under his father's plan. Like the sun and moon, the couple could hardly see each other despite that they were living in the same city, but their love endured amidst the separation and opposition from Moon's mother. Overcoming the challenges from teachers, friends and family, time has come for Sun to depart..(n)

programme.title: 惡行之外
programme.desc: One rainy night, the dead body of a girl, the only daughter of Hong Kong police Yin Lok, is found in the wild. Polices based on clues, suspect has been identified. However, several more girls are murdered and murder cases keep happening. Yin begins to investigate his daughter's death and met a mentally retarded girls, he is looking for more clues from this special girl. Finally, Yin is getting closer to the truth..(n)

programme.title: 少年的你
programme.desc: On the cusp of China's competitive national college entrance exams, Nian, a 17-year-old schoolgirl becomes the target of school bullying after a fellow classmate committed suicide. She later discovers an unlikely ally in Bei, an orphaned street youth. He becomes her protector and they form a unique bond that is soon tested when they are both implicated in a murder.(n)

programme.title: 我們的十八歲
programme.desc: This is a story about how family can impact the growth of a young woman. It follows Elaine, who grew up in poverty in the 1980's, and her best friend Ying as they enter the Hong Kong entertainment industry to change their fate. In the golden era of Hong Kong cinema, Ying becomes a popular erotic star while Elaine struggles between her identity and her job as an actor. When Hong Kong cinema's glory fades a decade later, the two women end up on diverging paths due to their life choices.(n)

programme.title: 獵戰
programme.desc: After a high-ranking North Korean official requests asylum, KCIA Foreign Unit chief Park Pyong-ho (LEE Jung Jae) and Domestic Unit chief Kim Jung-do (JUNG Woo Sung) are tasked with uncovering a North Korean spy, known as Donglim, who is deeply embedded within their agency. When the spy begins leaking top secret intel that could jeopardize national security, the two units are each assigned to investigate each other. In this tense situation where if they cannot find the mole, they may be accused themselves, Pyong-ho and Jung-do slowly start to uncover the truth. In the end, they must deal with an unthinkable plot to assassinate the South Korean president..(n)

programme.title: 消失的情人節
programme.desc: Hsiao-chi (Patty Lee) is a young woman who always rushes and gets things done quickly. However, she has made no progress in her love life and remains single in her late twenties. Every day, Hsiao-chi repeats the same work at the counter in the post office. Amongst all sorts of customers who Hsiao-chi has to deal with is a bus driver called Tai (Liu Kuan-ting); Tai is as slow as a sloth and comes to Hsiao-chi in the post office to send a letter by ordinary delivery every day. Longing for a romance, Hsiao-chi cannot believe that handsome Wenson (Duncan Chou) chats her up and asks her out. As Valentine's Day is approaching, Hsiao-chi looks so much forward to going on a date she has dreamt of, but to her astonishment, Valentine's Day has disappeared when she wakes up from sleep.(n)

programme.title: 三不管
programme.desc: In one of the darkest and diverse cultural part in the city, there is a minority group who lives in the place where it is full of despair and frustration. At first glance, their desperate living comprises illegal gambling, prostitution as well as drug-dealing. Indeed, their way of living is guided by their own norms and laws, regardless of the entrenched ones prevailing in the general public. Although their norms are chaotic and arbitrary, they do not violate the existence of the conventional ones. Consequently, it can be said that this chaotic region is unique within the city. On one occasion, there are two men, riding in a vehicle, unexpectedly enter this restricted region..(n)

programme.title: 我的幸福婚約
programme.desc: In a fictional Japan of Meiji Era, a time of remarkable civilization and enlightenment, people from families that have inherited special abilities [inou] have been protecting people from various disasters together with the emperor who rules the country. Miyo Saimori was from one of the prestigious families but born without the ability, and has lived her whole life being abused by her stepmother and half-sister. She is ordered to marry a ruthless soldier, Kiyoka Kudo, who leads the Alien Force at a young age, as a political ploy. True to the rumors that numerous potential fiancees had fled within three days, Kiyoka coldly told Miyo, 'You must obey me here. If I tell you to leave, leave. If I tell you to die, you die.” Miyo, who has no place to run away to, realizes during her stay at the Kudo household that Kiyoka is not the man he is reputed to be. Kiyoka is also touched by Miyo's thoughtfulness, and the two eventually establishes a special bond with each other. A light shine.(n)

programme.title: 狄仁傑之四大天王
programme.desc: Mysterious events keep happening in Luoyang: warriors wearing totem masks perpetrate crime all around the city; the fox outside the bar begins to speak human language; dragons on the column of the palace come alive; the Heavenly Kings in the temple show its angry face. Dee needs to solve the puzzles behind the mysterious cases, while facing obstacles from Empress Wu.(n)

programme.title: 冤鴦大盜
programme.desc: Dojo and May are a loving couple. Because Dojo has a brain tumor and needs 1 million baht for the operation, they decide to rob a money exchange store. Unluckily, the couple with 10 unfortunate patrons of the money exchange center are held hostages by 3 professional robbers on the same day. It is a robbery inside another robbery as well as some secrets among these people will be revealed. What could possibly happen when these people are trapped in the store with no way to escape.(n)

programme.title: 曾經擁有
programme.desc: Anyone who has anything to do with the film industry in Hong Kong, must have heard of a film buff called Lil' Kim. He knows everything there is to know about filmmaking. Whether it's on the set, at the movie premiere or at a press conference, he always shows up uninvited. Nobody knows where he came from and why he showed up... Ginger Keung is the producer of a reality show who suspects Lil' Kim is in fact a film critic who pans movies to extort advertising dollars from film companies. She zeroes in on Lil' Kim as her next target and decides to dig into his elusive past..(n)

programme.title: 衝上雲霄
programme.desc: Young pilot Branson recently takes over Skylette, his father's aviation empire, only to realize his old flames Cassie is a flight attendant there. Several years ago, he was forced to break up with her and move to New York to take care of his father's business. To this day, the two continue to harbor feelings for each other but decide to keep them bottled up. In an effort to rebrand the airline, Branson invites rock idol TM to star in an upcoming commercial and appoints Sam as her flying consultant. Incongruent in both tastes and experience, this odd couple gets off on the wrong foot. As the shoot progresses, however, they slowly discover each other's merits, developing a strong mutual attraction. Jayden has left Skylette Airline to become a pilot for private jets. He meets the young and vivacious Kika during a flight and assumes her to be wayward and shallow. But they turn out to have a lot in common and start falling madly in love. At the height of their romance, Jayden real.(n)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -「靚」媽駕到
programme.desc: Hong Kong Film Awards' Best Actress winner Anita Yuen with the cast from Malaysia share fun episodes of their collaboration in ‘OMG! Mom's Big News'. Anita shares about her kiss scene with Chan Fong playing as her husband in the film. Their “children” Miko Wong and Juztin Lan also reveal how they were stunned by Anita's aura and skill of breaking the ice when or even before filming. Let's find out what Anita did to win over hearts of the crew.(n)

programme.title: 決戰中女社: 陀槍師奶 x 新紮師姐
programme.desc: Mi-young', once a legendary detective, is stationed behind a desk in the civil complaints department after having a baby. 'Ji-hye', a hardheaded young detective, is consigned to Mi-young's team as disciplinary measure. At home, they are sisters-in-law who are always at each other's throats. One day, a distressed young woman visits the department..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -逃出大風鎮
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.(n)

programme.title: 鬼們之蝴蝶大廈
programme.desc: A young mother and her child move into Room 606 of the infamous Butterfly Mansion, a notorious haunted building in the heart of Taipei. From the moment they arrive, eerie paranormal events begin to unfold, pushing her to uncover the dark secrets lurking within its walls. Amid the chaos, the building's new janitor-a kind and seemingly helpful young man-offers his support. But behind his warm smile lies a mystery of his own. As their paths intertwine, she realizes that everyone carries their own shadows, and the deeper she digs, the closer she gets to a chilling revelation. In Butterfly Mansion, the greatest lesson she learns is this: Humans Are More Terrifying Than Ghosts.(n)

programme.title: 快一秒的他
programme.desc: Hajime is a handsome young man, who is always a second quicker than everyone else. He works at the post office, where Reika comes to buy a stamp every day. Reika is a young woman, who is always a second slower than everyone else. On the day after Valentine's Day, Hajime wakes up to find himself losing all his memories from the previous day... A remake of the Best Film Winner at the Taipei Golden Horse Awards, My Missing Valentine, and relocating the story to Kyoto, the film tells a quirky romance caught in unexpected time differences.(n)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(n)

programme.title: 吹哨人
programme.desc: An earthquake of 6.6 magnitude strikes Malawi in southeast Africa. Eco Energy Technology, an Australian energy conglomerate with business in the region, sends its rescue team for emergency response. Meanwhile, in an exclusive resort in Australia, Chinese expatriate Mark (Lei Jiayin) runs into his ex-lover Wen (Tang Wei), now married to the chairman of Han Coal Group. Their old feelings rush back but soon he is dragged into something bigger with Wen... and turn into a night of passion, before Wen flies off to China in the morning. That afternoon, Mark is devastated to learn that the plane Wen took has crashed, with no sign of survivors. Two weeks have passed. Mark is trying to leave the past behind, when a mysterious call puts him in limbo. Mark discovers Wen cheats death after failing to catch the flight. Before figuring out the next step, they are tracked down by killers wherever they flee. Someone obviously wants her dead for good. Hopelessly outpowered, Mark pledges to pro.(n)

programme.title: 白塔之光
programme.desc: Gu Wentong, a middle-aged food critic, is drifting through the local eateries of vibrant Beijing with his younger photographer colleague Oyang. A divorce with a 6-year-old daughter and estranged from his father for decades, he is looking for a new perspective on life while reconsidering his failings as a father, a son, and a lover. While the seasons come and go, people get together and move apart. Only one thing will remain the same: The White Pagoda where they all meet sooner or later..(n)

programme.title: 我的湊B日記
programme.desc: ‘Ah-young', a grown orphan with government aid cut off, starts working as a nanny for ‘Young-chae', a single mother who works at a bar to make ends meet. One day, while Ah-young is asleep, Young-chae comes home drunk and seriously injures her baby by mistake. As Young-chae blames it on Ah-young, they drift apart. Then one day, Ah-young finds out that Young-chae is trying to give her baby up for adoption, and goes to stop her.(n)

programme.title: 哪一天我們會飛
programme.desc: Unfulfilled at work and dissatisfied with her marital life, a middle-aged woman attends a high school reunion and finds a floodgate of flashbacks of her salad days open before her mind's eyes. She was inseparable with two boys 20 years ago but married one of them eventually. All the memories eventually zero in on one critical incident that changed her life and those of the boys forever..(n)

programme.title: 老師！你會不會談戀愛
programme.desc: Ohno is an introverted math tutor at a cram school who can barely hold a conversation. He wants to fall in love and get married, like an “ordinary” person, but it just doesn't work out whenever he tries. Then his savior appears: a teenage girl named Kasumi, who knows all about “normal love”. The two of them team up to try and help Ohno in his romance.(n)

programme.title: 美人魚
programme.desc: Hin's real estate project involved reclamation of the sea, threatening the livelihood of the residents who relied on the sea to make a living. Bearing family secrets, Shan was dispatched to stop Hin. During their encounters, they fall in love with each other. Even though Hin stopped the reclamation plan out of his love for Shan, Shan got injured in an accident and vanished into the sea.(n)

programme.title: 爆谷電影背後
programme.desc: Bring you the behind-the-scene of this much anticipated Chinese blockbuster directed, co-written, and co-produced by Stephen Chow. Tune-in here for《Mermaid》.(n)

programme.title: 我的天堂城市
programme.desc: Three stories, three struggles for survival, strung together in search of happiness. My Heavenly City uses three interconnected stories to explore the hopeful aspirations of new Asian immigrants moving to New York City – the city of their dreams. We follow a lonely young woman moving to the city to work as a Chinese-English translator, a young couple obsessed with hip-hop and parents dealing with a child with mental illness. They unknowingly influence each other as their paths cross, affecting each other in ways as they go about their lives.(n)

programme.title: 低一點的天空
programme.desc: Fat Cat, a nickname because of his chubby body, is a moderately mentally handicapped person. He works happily and passionately as a delivery boy in a restaurant. Little Cheung is a spastic with normal IQ working as an office boy. Fairy Snow White, name it after a renowned Chinese opera actress, is a blissful, middle-class daughter. Her bright future suddenly turned vague when she became blind at age twelve. From then on, she is living in the dark, but her childhood memories enable her to live in peace and harmony. Fat Cat, Little Cheung and Snow White become good friends afterwards, sharing their respective dream. They don't think it is feasible except Fat Cat does..(n)

programme.title: 三人行
programme.desc: Zhau is a young doctor who desperately needs a successful operation on a high-profile patient to redeem a previous failure which not only cost the life of a patient but her self-esteem. Han is a suspect of multiple armed robberies and homicides, who has been taken to the hospital after being shot with a bullet in his head during a showdown with the police. Officer Lok is at first sight a gung-ho policeman who has participated in the showdown, but when he makes desperate attempts to do Han in by exploiting Zhau's weaknesses, it is apparent he is harboring a much darker secret..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(n)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -聽不見的擂台
programme.desc: Sho Miyake, the Japanese director of Small, Slow but Steady, has showed up in Hong Kong to promote and present this ‘hushed' boxing film to the audience face-to-face. What is the meaning within his film? And how he made use of sound arrangements in order to allow audience experience a world like the main character of hearing-impaired does? In this episode, he will also reveal his reason of using 16mm film so that had repetitive takes avoided by actor in this work.(n)

programme.title: 決戰中女社: 惠子的凝視
programme.desc: Despite battling lifelong deafness, Keiko has managed to turn pro and obtain a winning record. But as her mentor faces health issues and her gym faces imminent closure due to the pandemic, Keiko finds her will to keep fighting starting to wane.(n)

programme.title: 片場職人 -劉永
programme.desc: Anthony Lau, the popular actor in the 1970s, was actually Bruce Lee's protege and known for their work in acclaimed action films. Despite the popularity and recognition for his roles as emperor in TV drama series, he failed to continue success due to personal life but after half a century at this career he has never forgotten his master's teachings. In this episode, Anthony recounts the precious moments with Bruce and unveils his own acting journey.(n)

programme.title: 小白龍情海翻波
programme.desc: 'Little White Dragon', a noblewoman and a kung fu hero whose beauty soon caught the eyes of the crown prince. He sent White Dragon to capture an assassin, a blind swordsman..(n)

programme.title: 該死的阿修羅
programme.desc: During the night of his 18th birthday, Jan-Wen committed a random shooting homicide in the crowed night-market, with his self-made modified gun and for some mysterious reasons. The tragic incident caused the life of his family and friends, the victims, and the witnesses all facing the tremendous impact in the aftermath. However, what if there was a chance for these people to make different choices, will the tragedy remain? Will it be a brand new outcome if they all altered their behavior at the crucial moment.(n)

programme.title: 衝鋒車
programme.desc: Lucifer and his gangsters dress their minibus to resemble a police vehicle, and pose as policemen for a robbery. At the robbery the gangsters engage in a gunfight against the real criminals, who kill randomly. Lucifer and his men are infuriated. They may wear police costumes and use toy guns, but their passion is real. Sensing their righteous passion, Chui decides to side with the imposters and their 16-passenger EU vehicle. Lucifer and his men re-discover the bond they felt when they used to battle together.(n)

programme.title: 導火線
programme.desc: Yen's Inspector Ma involved in a difficult case versus a trio of deadly Vietnamese bad guys. Inspector Ma's partner Wilson poses as a member of the gang to keep tabs on the trio, leading to the arrest of Archer. However, Archer's cohorts Tony and Tiger are still at large, and will stop at nothing to prevent Wilson and other witnesses from testifying..(n)

programme.title: 漫長的一天
programme.desc: A story about people meeting and parting with each other as they wander through a dreamlike day. They are all wandering, in her memories, in his novel and in their movies. An omnibus film that explores hellos, goodbyes, longings and reunions throughout the events of a single day.(n)

programme.title: 繼續爭氣
programme.desc: In 2013, My Voice, My Life followed classes of students from three high schools for underprivileged kids and one school for the visually impaired as they embarked on a voyage of self-discovery through taking part in a musical production. Six years later, what kinds of lives are they leading now? My Voice, My Life Revisited goes in search of four of those students: Ah Bok, Coby, Sio Fan and Tsz Nok, charting their transformation and how they have grown over these past few years, as well as the challenges they are facing today.(n)

programme.title: 信用欺詐師JP：英雄篇
programme.desc: The “Third Generation Tsuchinoko” -- the master con man hailed as a “hero” has died. Dako, Boku-chan and Richard all honed their skills under his tutelage. The title of 'Tsuchinoko' is handed down in secrecy to the Confidence Man (scammer) with the greatest skill, setting the stage for a showdown between his three star pupils. The contest will take place in the world heritage city of Valletta, Malta, an international gathering place for the rich and famous.Their target is the invaluable ancient Greek sculpture “Dancing Venus”, currently owned by a wealthy, retired Spanish gangster. Each scammer adopts a unique strategy in pursuit of the target, but the police and Interpol are also hot on their heels. Who will laugh last?! No one knows how the biggest scam in history will end! Who is the true 'hero' and what is the ultimate 'truth'? The last con game, grand finale, Battle Royale...begins now.(n)

programme.title: 奪冠
programme.desc: With glorious days from five consecutive championships in the 1980s, the Women's National Volleyball Team of China had transcended the conventional definition of sports in the hearts of Chinese people. When the Chinese team was pitted against the US team led by Lang Ping at the 2008 Beijing Volleyball Game, everyone knew that it was a match that China could not lose, and certainly could not afford to lose. Defeated, the Chinese team plunged into the deepest abyss in three decades. As Lang Ping returned to her country to coach the team, many mused aloud as to whether China's Women's National Volleyball Team would be able to retrieve lost grounds. The film recounts the ups and downs, the sweat and sacrifice of the team over the past four decades. While the team's persistence and teamwork became a national inspiration and collective memory in the 80s, whether the team spirit can be passed down to the new generation as China goes through rapid changes.(n)

programme.title: 我的麻煩老友
programme.desc: A-Gan is a mean and stingy but successful salesman. One day he has a car accident and meets his own conscious. His Conscious just gives him 7 days to live. A-Gan convinces it to let him live on if 7 people come and visit him. Disappointed by his colleagues' attitudes, A-Gan meets A-Tong, a girl who is as rude and mean as him. They finally change their bad personalities and A-Gan saves his own life by having 7 visitors.(n)

programme.title: 搶紅
programme.desc: Shui Zhang and Waley were buddies at an orphanage. Adopted by a French couple and moved to France at a young age, Waley has become a wine connoisseur prodigy. Left alone in China, Shui Zhang grows up to be a braggart and a nobody. When Shui Zhang travels to France one day to enlist Waley's help in auctioning a bottle of red wine called 'The God of Wine,' said to contain Kublai Khan's secret wine-brewing recipe, Waley accepted the challenge in a heartbeat. During the auction, Waley encounters a representative from the seller, the beautiful Yvonne, and falls in love with her at first sight. The other potential buyer is the wealthy and imposing coal tycoon Changfang Fang. While he appears to be a rich and vulgar brute on the surface, he is much more than meets the eyes. Adding to the mystery is the private connoisseur of suspicious origins following Fang everywhere. To Waley's surprise, Zhang and Fang seem to be sharing secrets between themselves. The group of buyers set off an.(n)

programme.title: 拳霸無銀用
programme.desc: Thongpoon wants to produce a movie by using his gift of martial art to be a leading actor. Without money, he joins a boxing gambling for finding funds, but at last he becomes a prizefighter unexpectedly.(n)

programme.title: 老鼠愛上貓
programme.desc: Based on the popular Chinese novel Qi Xia Wu Yi about the story of Judge Pao in the Song Dynasty and his group of heroic helpers, who together solve cases and catch criminals galore. In the original story, Zhan Zhao is constantly at loggerheads with Bai Yutong, a Robin Hood figure who assists Judge Pao from the other side of the law. Their conflict experiences a modern rendition in this hilariously iconoclastic film.(n)

programme.title: 片場職人 -伍允龍
programme.desc: From stuntman to action choreographer, Phillip Ng's presence has spanned the spectrum of cinematic martial arts. What is it about martial arts that captivates him, driving his dedication to Hong Kong film industry? In this episode, Phillip is going to talk about his self-preparation as a stuntman and dissect the aesthetics of action films.(n)

programme.title: 決戰中女社: 女士復仇
programme.desc: If hell hath no fury like a woman scorned, imagine the nightmare that's about to be visited upon the man who has scorned three women. Professional killer Chanel has been happily married for ten years, but she discovers that her husband has been carrying on an affair with Dior, a thief. Before the women can tear each other apart, they learn that he also has a third woman, Hermes. When the avenging duo arrives at a hotel to stop their next rendezvous, they find out that Hermes is ready for war.(n)

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....(n)

programme.title: 錢作怪
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor..

programme.title: 賭神
programme.desc: King of Gambles Gao Jin has been asked by Shangshan of Japan to play a decisive gamble with Devil of Gambles. He finds out Brother Nan in charge of the gamble is playing tricks..

programme.title: 我愛一碌葛
programme.desc: Kudzu, Mud Carp and Bean depend on each other for survival since their parents died. Kudzu, the eldest of three sisters, gave up her studies and runs a fish stall in Luen Yee Hui market to raise her two young sisters. She is a super fan of the famous Singer, Alex. Mud Carp, the second sister, becomes a lawyer after university. Her boyfriend, David, comes from a rich family. In view of this, she dares not tell David her family background even though they are planning to get married. Kudzu always hopes her youngest sister Bean, to further her studies but she falls in love with a middle-aged butcher, Wing. One day, Kudzu discovers that her good friend, Keung, has a long-lost brother, and comes to the hopeful conclusion that his lost brother is Alex. In the process of helping Keung to find his brother, the relationship between the three sisters changed..

programme.title: 唐伯虎點秋香
programme.desc: Tong Park Foo is the top-grade scholar in Suzhou. On a feast day, Tong and his friends go to visit the temple and there, Tong meets Chau Heung for the first time. Tong is shaken at Chau's beauty. He decides to go after her. But Chau's master Mrs. Wah is very angry with Tong's family, how can Tong make Chau Heung his bride.

programme.title: 情人知己
programme.desc: Chi is equipped with superb gaming skills, and because of that he is a very egoistic and lazy worker. One day he flirts with a girl who happen to be a mafia boss' girlfriend..

programme.title: 洪熙官
programme.desc: Hung Hei Kwun, a kungfu student of Shaolin, is against the Manchu rulers. Hong's whole family was arrested and later beheaded. Hong killed Ning-Erh Ma in revenge and escaped with his youngest son, Man-Ting , to nowhere land. Several years later, Chishan, Father Superior of the Shaolin Temple, found a map to a treasure trove but contents were tattooed on the backs of his five young masters. If missing one master, the trove could not be found..

programme.title: 繼續跳舞
programme.desc: Chang and Ao are twin sisters. Ao is a lunatic and stays in a mental hospital. Chang is 'cheated' into the hospital, exchanging identity with her insane sister. The mad house is lived by all kinds of weirdos. The 'game' is that Chang will stay in the hospital only for a while. But strangely enough, she gradually becomes more and more ease with the way of life in the hospital until one day, she's forgotten what life is like outside, including her fiance. Meanwhile, Ao is out looking for her ex-husband Ma Shih-mei who heartlessly deserted her. She meets the postman who has a secret infatuation with Chang. She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over..

programme.title: 影后曼人迷: 精裝追女仔
programme.desc: Fred, foul-mouthed, together with his two close buddies, Silver and Tony, are working in a garage. Their boss, Ken, is harsh and dingy. However, a warm and close friendship has been established among the four. In order to recover the heartbreak of Fred, Ken suggested a tour to Penang to cheer up Fred. They came across two beautiful girls, Maggie and Agnes, strolling leisurely on the beach as if they were very wealthy. Since then they decided on courtship. They played a poker game to decide who's to who. And Fred, the winner, chose Maggie to be his sole target. By the rules of the game, Ken, Silver and Tong have to compete to see who in the ends will win the heart of Agnes..

programme.title: 賭俠
programme.desc: Little Knife is following in his master's footsteps and rapidly rising in th gambling world. Sing Chi would like to be the God of Gamblers' disciple and ask him for help..

programme.title: 金玉滿堂
programme.desc: Directed by Tsui Hark, a comedy with star cast led by Leslie Cheung. Two rival chefs must unite and compete against an egotistical master gourmet chef for 'The #1 Chef' title.

programme.title: 特務迷城
programme.desc: Buck trails two suspicious men and jumps into action to foil their plans. Soon after he meets Liu, who convince Buck that he may be the long-lost son of a rich korean businessman..

programme.title: 陰陽路
programme.desc: “Troublesome Night” comprises four individual stories. First story: “Tombstone Copying” A group of four boys and three girls went camping together and at night, they told scary ghosts stories. Then Ku Tin Lok suggested to visit a nearby cemetery and took down the information of the deceased which was inscribed on the tomb. Suddenly, they found a newly built tomb and it turned out to belong to one of them; Second Story: “Scarlet Red” Three youngsters went to Bao Fu Shan Cemetery to pay respect to their friends. At the cemetery, Mak Ka Kei caught sight of Sunny Chan‘s tomb and was sorry for his premature death. Since Mak was wearing red underpants and ghosts tend to follow and adhere to red things, Mak was thus possessed..

credits.director: 鄭偉文, 譚朗昌, 邱禮濤

programme.title: 香江花月夜
programme.desc: There was a kid who used to serve with his father in a night club‘s washroom. By chance, he became a singer and turned into the hottest star in the club. His teacher however, fell from his golden days. As the teacher realized that “Nothing Lasts Forever”, he was content with his quiet and simple life. The story took place in a night club in the sixties. Zhang Jiawing was a cheerful kid. His best friend Gao Zhi was a shoe boy. Gao‘s father disappeared after losing all his money in stock speculation. The two kids became students to the once renowned singer Johnny, whose career was at low ebb. Johnny had great hopes on them. He vowed to make them become the best of the best..

programme.title: 霹靂先鋒
programme.desc: Cheung Tit-hong has recorded numerous meritorious deeds, but he is by nature uncontrollable and antagonistic to his bureaucratic superiors. Before reporting his work to his superiors, he has already successfully arrested the gangsters who steal motorbikes. He also saved an innocent teacher from being wrongly accused of theft by recognizing a female pickpocket. Finally, he has subdued fierce armed robbers in the gambling casino by flexibly utilizing a car thief, Boy. The contradictions in working style between Cheung and his superiors naturally lead to numerous scenes of strong conflicts..

programme.title: 繼續跳舞
programme.desc: Chang and Ao are twin sisters. Ao is a lunatic and stays in a mental hospital. Chang is 'cheated' into the hospital, exchanging identity with her insane sister. The mad house is lived by all kinds of weirdos. The 'game' is that Chang will stay in the hospital only for a while. But strangely enough, she gradually becomes more and more ease with the way of life in the hospital until one day, she's forgotten what life is like outside, including her fiance. Meanwhile, Ao is out looking for her ex-husband Ma Shih-mei who heartlessly deserted her. She meets the postman who has a secret infatuation with Chang. She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over..

programme.title: 殺手的童話
programme.desc: Judge was one of the top killers of ICE's syndicate. Mr. Tung Fai, a super cop attempted to sue the Triad head, Godfather “Tiger”. Unfortunately, his witness gave false testimony. Worst still, the witness was shot by Judge who impersonated as the presiding Judge in the law court. Meanwhile, Judge met Ru-fung, sister of Ice and both fell in love. The two killers understood they could not have true love. They decided to enjoy love for 3 days, and then separate and return to their killing carrier again.

programme.title: 神偷次世代
programme.desc: Mac, a professional thief, and three others organize commercial thieves together. While stealing a cancer vaccine, they find a pre-set bomb which it is a setup against them..

programme.title: 龍之家族
programme.desc: Hong Kong's godfather Dragon family believes his underworld should turn legitimate. His four 'families' support him but the 'pusher' violates the agreement. Dragon has him executed in public. But White Wolf No.2 in command, starts to challenge the old man. His two assistants, Joseph and Kirl, who intend to take over the narotic trade, set a trap for Tom, one of Dragon's six sons. In the melee, Kirl kills Dragon. Joseph persuades White Wolf to a massacre of the Dragon Family and the four 'families' during the funeral. At the same times, he kills White Wolf and sets his foot in the high society..

programme.title: 契媽唔易做
programme.desc: A Chinese illegal immigrant “Cousin” wrongly trusted his friend Kwok to rob a jewellery shop. Kwok managed to escape and Cousin is so scared to hide himself in the vehicle which is rented by Ah Ching to remove to the rural area. Ah Ching is suffered by the high pressure from her work and city life. She also has to worry about her boyfriend Fai who is a police inspector. She is determined to pack up and move into remote area to escape from all this. She doesn't know a stranger (Cousin) is right at her back. Ah Ching meets with Pak Lam who is reared in the village by his greedy father Uncle Tat. Ah Ching finds it so ridiculous that naturally she sympathizes the kid. Pak Lam visits Ah Ching's new home to play TV games. He bumped into the scared Cousin who is still hiding there. He and Pak Lam come into an agreement not to reveal his identity to the others. Cousin has no attention to hurt anybody. He even stands out to protect Ah Ching and Pak Lam when the gangs in the village tr.

programme.title: 君子好逑
programme.desc: A group of intellectuals, who all actively involved in a psychological research, assume a subject Fai, who is innocent and aimless in his life, to test if love can make him into a different person. Jo Jo is the chosen girl to carry out the mission, who attracts Fai with her elegance and beauty. At the same time, she finds herself attracted by him. She wants Professor Cheung, her boyfriend, to stop such a cruel test, but she fails. The final commitment comes when Jo Jo marries to Cheung. Fai interrupts the wedding ceremony in the church by announcing his love to Jo Jo..

programme.title: 龍跨四海
programme.desc: SHIKO is brought up in a Japanese underworld family but lives with her mother in England after her parents' separation while her elder brother TARO stays with her father BUTA. In a business trip to Paris, SHIKO meets a Chinese illegal immigrant CHIN-SHUI who can only earn his living by working for the Chinatown triads. The stepping in of SHIKO brings a tremendous change to his life. After the assassination for the triads in Paris, CHIN-SHUI flees to England and stays with his Chinese friend, FA-CHIN, who always loves SHIKO. Both SHIKO and CHIN-SHUI fall in love. The company that SHIKO works for is owned by her father BUTA. Both BUTA and TARO discovers NAKAMURI's corrupt practices in their company..

programme.title: 影后曼人迷: 阿飛正傳
programme.desc: A self-obsessed man, desperately seeking his true identity, York plays carelessly with his lovers and his friends before leaving them all to the Philippines in search of the truth..

programme.title: 至尊無上
programme.desc: Sam and Crab are a pair of skilled gamblers. When Sam chooses to leave the life, Crab engages the vengeful attention of Yakuza. The gangsters strike back by kidnapping Sam's girl..

programme.title: 陰陽路4與鬼同行
programme.desc: Leonardo, DiCaprio and Driver joined a bargain tour to Philippines, hoping that they could feast all they could on the local girls as well as those traveling with them. They were excited to see that two wantons, U2 and K2 had joined their tour with a pretty tour guide Yan. They thought they would enjoy themselves, but in fact, they were heading for their death..

programme.title: 伊波拉病毒
programme.desc: Ten years ago, Kai, a local gangster was caught in bed with his boss's wife, he killed both the boss and his wife. The boss's daughter Lily witnessed the murders and managed to escape afterwards. As the police were looking for him, Kai was forced to disappear... For the last ten years, Kai has worked in a Chinese restaurant in Johannesburg in South Africa after being smuggled into the country. The restaurant owner Brother Kei and his wife Ling takes advantage of Kai's situation and treat him badly. One day Kai goes to buy meat from a native tribe, he is unaware of that a terrible epidemic – the Ebola virus has broken out among the tribesmen. During the trip Kai rapes and murders a black girl who is infected with the disease. Kai has no idea he is carrying the disease, his body creates an antibody which means he is a carrier but the disease won't affect him..

programme.title: 絕代雙驕
programme.desc: Master, The of Eva Palace enters the valley in search of 10 Untouchable Villians. Despite being married and having a child together, she and Yin fight each other without remorse.

programme.title: 暴風眼
programme.desc: Few years ago, Sergeant Kong in a mission to capture the head of the “East Rail Corporation” met with Yip Fung who killed the head of East Rail instead. Kong shot at Yip but missed and only a finger was left in the scene. Kong suspected that Yip might be a robot and thus kept a close watch on her, but later turned that he fell in love with Yip. One night, Ko Kit accompanied with four assistants launched a campaign to steal the “Crystal” in East Rail Main Building. Ko was successful in breaking through the security system and got the crystal but at the same time Yip also rushed to join in the robbery..

programme.title: 冒險王
programme.desc: “The Scripture With No Words” had been lost for a long time. Everybody was eager to find it, even the ambitious Japanese. Dr. Wai was antiquarian.
