Having seen the mysterious “Wooden Horse”, lost control and killing people, he quit his job. However, being supported by his friend, Dr. Wai recovered and resumed to his work. He went to Shanghai trying to locate “The Scripture With No Words” and he discovered that it was in the possession of the leader of “Gang of Salt”. And the game begin..

programme.title: 賭神3之少年賭神
programme.desc: At the first God of Gamblering contest, Ko Chun is told to lose the contest as his master's interests in betting the champion. Ko refuses and is shot by his enraged master..

programme.title: 江湖情
programme.desc: Yung was caught red-handed in making a mischief. He and his friend Ying Hung decided to rob Chu Lo Tai. However, the attempt of robbery was unsuccessful and they were pursued..

programme.title: 五億探長雷洛傳 II之父子情仇
programme.desc: Lee Rock realizes the promotion is indeed the manoeuvre of his surrender of power. So he decides it is the right time to resign. His son, Yin, has graduated and joins the ICAC...

programme.title: 沙灘仔與周師奶
programme.desc: Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow have been partners in the police force for years. While investigating a special case, Beach Boy met Ah Yuk whose step-father was one of the crime members. Ah Yuk was alone in Hong Kong and Beach Boy first pitied her, then later fell in love with her. Beach Boy's superior, Inspector Lee Nam who appears to be honest is actually one of the Taiwanese group. He set up Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow. He also courted Ah Yuk..

programme.title: 夏日的麼麼茶
programme.desc: Summer flies to an island to sell a resort that is invested by her and her cousin. She meets Momocha who claims to be the authentic owner of the hotel. They begin a battle of love..

programme.title: 抱擁朝陽
programme.desc: Han Zhiyi‘s father took his life after he was rigged by Yi Zufen and Zhiyi was forced to close down her family business. She was distressed and went for a vacation with her mother. They left Shanghai and joined a cruise to Hong Kong. On the liner, she met billionaire Tong Paixian who fell deeply in love with her at first sight..

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 決戰紫禁之巔
programme.desc: The story is set in the Ming dynasty. 'Holy Sword' requests a fight with secret agent 009's friend 'God of Sword' to decide the world's best swordsman. During the contest on the roof of the Forbidden City, 009 realises that 'Holy Sword' has sent a double to fight in his place, while he plans to assassinate the emperor. 'Holy Sword' finds himself surrounded by thousands of palace guards but is rescued by 'God of Sword', who wants to complete their championship..

programme.title: 江湖接班人
programme.desc: Sammy is a man of honour. He lives by the underworld's code of honour. He helps friends and kills enemies, for instance, Ng Kong who got him 3 years behind bars. Sammy is now a fugitive in Taiwan being protected by Kui, one of the gang leaders. Once Kui injures Peter, his opposition and young Crow takes the rap. Sammy and Crow become friends. Sammy tries to mediate between Kui and Peter but finds out being used by Kui to eliminate Peter. He wants out. But Crow joins Kui's gang after killing Peter. Sammy retires to Crow's home town and falls in love with his sister. Kui begins to turn against Crow. He sends Crow to Hong Kong and orders to kill him. Crow escapes back to Taiwan, only to find his girlfriend has committed suicide after Kui's gang has raped her. At the same moment, Kui's men come for him and kill his sister who comes with Sammy to deliver their wedding news. With Sammy by his side, Crow starts his vendetta..

programme.title: 至尊無上之永霸天下
programme.desc: Though persuaded by his brother, Chicken Wing, Kit refused to gamble again. However, Tommy keeps on harassing them, Kit finally decided to take revenge..

programme.title: 大三元
programme.desc: Priest Hung Zhong met Bai Xuehua, a debt-ridden call girl who hid in the church‘s confession booth from the loan sharks. To help her, Zhong went in disguise to rent and live in her apartment. Zhong found new jobs for all the call girls, cultivated their interest in music and went to negotiate with the triad members who controlled them. On the other hand, CID Liu Qingfa followed Bai closely to investigate into an illicit prostitution case during which he and Zhong had many misunderstandings. In the end, will he able to solve the case? Can the girls turn over a new leaf? Zhong and Hua came to develop special feelings for each other, but as a priest, what will Zhong do.

programme.title: 愛上我吧
programme.desc: Lobo and Skid are very close friends. They study in the same class, and they both grow up without their mothers. The two buddies often play in a band and play skateboards with their classmates. Soda, one of their classmates, has many girlfriends concurrently, and Suki is his closet girlfriend. Fion is another classmate. She is addicted to chat in phone with friends and strangers every day. She always thinks she will find a true love from playing line. One day, she has an argument with her boyfriend on street, and Pat, an innocent girl, saw the incident..

programme.title: 有情飲水飽
programme.desc: Richard Ma is a tightfisted, mean and unpleasant character. He is also a wealthy businessman who has become increasingly bitter and mistrustful due to what he believes are the gold-digging women in his life. Following a series of events one weekend, Richard's financial assets are temporarily frozen, his house is looted by his bitter ex-girlfriend and he has no cash leaving him helpless and broke. It is during this fateful weekend that he meets Choi; a struggling stockbroker who is trying ward off the attentions of an unwanted suitor from her local village. By offering to help to Ah Choi in return for financial gain, a most surprising relationship develops between this unlikely pair.

programme.title: 最佳拍檔之醉街拍檔
programme.desc: Acted by her, Wan Ling has successfully conned two million dollars from gangster Brother Lei in a dirty deal. She was therefore hunted by Lei..

programme.title: 陽光警察
programme.desc: In order to enhance a fresh image, the police force selects O and Sammy as 'Sunshine Cops'. But the campaign is not met with the anticipated popularity..

programme.title: 川島芳子
programme.desc: Kawashima Yoshiko, the daughter of emperor Xu, was sent to Japan for training when she was an adolescent in order to rebuild Ching Empire. Yoshiko experienced many ups and downs, however, her life was a tragedy, ending up by being executed in Beijing when she was just forty-two.

programme.title: 英雄好漢
programme.desc: Lee Ah Chai, a native Chiu Chow, a province of China. He was married with children of his own. He was rich, powerful and influential and he was the leading man in the underworld, virtually to as the ‘Big Boss'. But he was unhappy. After spending so many years involving with vice and crime, he was sick of this world and wanted to start his life anew. Some ten years ago, Chai had two side-kicks, Tang Kar Yung and Chan Ting Kok. Kok was adopted by Uncle Cut, the father of Yung. The two boys were raised up together and they were like brothers, if not by blood. But a misconception broke out which overshadowed the relationship amongst the three of them. It led Chai and Yung to divergence and the fight of Kok to Malacca..

programme.title: 特警新人類
programme.desc: To fight against the new era criminals, Inspector Chan struggles for picking up a group of brand new cadets to become his new team called the 'Gen-X-Cops'..

programme.title: 愛情夢幻號
programme.desc: Rich guy Hok Chun, ever since his birth, people only flattered him and nobody dare to act against him. This time, he brought with him a girl Ching Man on the ship and proposed to engage to her. In fact, this was his ninth engagement. Ching Man seemed so perfect, knowledgeable and sociable which attracted Hok Chun very much. However, he did not know that she had secretly studied hard every night to prepare for a new topic to talk the next day. Ching Man was beginning to feel strained. At the same time, she met Lok Man, who was a waiter on board. When she was with Lok Man, she felt free, gradually they fall in love with each other..

programme.title: 橫紋刀劈扭紋柴
programme.desc: Chi-Wah and Siu-Suet get married. But Wah's mum feels unhappy about her new daughter-in-law since Siu-Suet does not meet her expectations. She plans to kick Siu-Suet out..

programme.title: 求戀期
programme.desc: The friends of Choi and his girlfriend Mimi always say that the two of them do not look like a couple. So, Choi decides to change his image to be more 'punky'. However, Mimi not only spurns his changes, but also feels there are some problems between them and asks for a break-up. Paul is a 'playboy'. In a rainy night, he meets Yung. She has an unpredictable character. Paul's courtship skills do not work on her. Paul is helpless. Indeed, Yung likes Paul but she is afraid that one day she may really fall in love with Paul so she goes back to Canada. Though unwilling, Paul has to put an end to this relationship.

programme.title: 至尊三十六計之偷天換日
programme.desc: Mindy is a top-notched gambler. During a card game, Mindy swindle millions of dollars, but they are caught. Lau makes a deal with Mindy that Mindy needs to go to prison..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: Yes一族
programme.desc: Five young men threw themselves with heart and soul into the work force. They have different approaches and different life styles. Ah Kit is the hardworking investment broker. He is so busy making money. Ah Chi is a postman believing in fung shui. Ah Hark is an apprentice in his family jewelry shop and Ah Wai failed in public exam. Ah Ming is the most unconventional of the five. Working in a Japanese restaurant. The five start a laundry shop which soon folds. Next, they try something new to save their business. Ah Ming leads a carefree life which dismays his girl, Yoko. Ah Hark's girlfriend Cat will move to Australia and leave him soon. Ah Ming and Ah Hark are going to lose their girlfriends. The five new generation are going their own ways..

programme.title: 至尊計狀元才
programme.desc: As a prominent gambler, Ray has encountered many challenges in his career. When Chiang challenges Ray to a gambling contest with him in Macau, Ray's adventures begins again..

programme.title: 太子傳說
programme.desc: Cheung is Prince, the son of crime boss Mr. Pak in the underworld. He kills flamboyantly with the help of partner Ching Ching, who was a gift from Mr. Pak many years ago. Still, despite Ching's constant companionship, Prince longs for a woman he has seen in his dreams since youth. The dream girl is a dancer Tweedy. He also longs to kill Drago, who was supposedly responsible for taking his mother away. Dragon actually has his own vendetta against Pak, as Pak kidnapped his son many years ago. The missing son turns up, and he's now a killer who goes by the name of Prince.

programme.title: 昨夜長風
programme.desc: Cai Mingjun was dumped by her boyfriend when he discovered she was pregnant. With the help and support from her friend Xu Yuyuan, Cai managed to give birth to the baby. For years, she struggled hard to build up her career to provide for the child‘s living. She was doing well when all of a sudden, her company was acquired by Xie's family. This led to a change in the company‘s policy and Cai came face to face with his ex-lover Zuo Sicheng. Zuo had married the daughter of Xie family and was trusted by his father-in-law. He became Cai's boss and made life very hard for her. He abused her with his power when he discovered that his wife Cai, he tried to make her resign. Fortunately, Xie Shiwen, the only son of the Xie family, intervened to lend Cai a hand..

programme.desc: Since the 1980's, Chan Hing Kai has created numerous love comedies, yet he opened up that he was “forced” to write them at that time. Later on, he wrote and co-directed “La Brassiere”, a film which entertains without being obscene. He reveals that one of the leading actor, Lau Ching Wan, complained to him afterwards... In this episode, Hing Kai is invited to share the untold stories from his writing career and talk about the changing ecology of screenwriting in the film industry.

programme.title: 妙探雙龍
programme.desc: Kent was a member of the underground gang in the United States. He was attacked by the gangsters upon holding the key evidence of their criminal offences. Kent had no alternative but to seek FBI's protection. He mailed the crime evidence to his sister in Hong Kong. At the same time, he disguised as a girl and fled to Hong Kong. Here he contacted Mr. Green Village, leader of the underground gang for the selling of the smuggled diamond. His identification was revealed by two CID, Ching Shing and Tai Kau. Kent was brought to the Police Station and put under close supervision. They waited for Cindy, the FBI Officer to extradite him to the States for testimony. Kent escaped before her arrival. At that time, professional killers were sent to search for Kent with the help of Mr. Green Village after bribing him. It started a fatal game of hide and seek among Kent, Cindy, the police and their killers..

programme.title: 三人世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex, just breaks up with his model girlfriend Peggy. In order to release Alex's anxiety, his friend invites him to be the part time director of a choir. Alex meets Vivian in the choir. However, Vivian's mother Chu Lai Ngo, a divorced woman who dislikes Alex at the first sight. When Alex and Chu are getting closer and closer, they imperceptibly fall in love with each other. At this moment, Peggy suddenly comes back to Alex asking for being together once again. Alex has to make his choice of love between these two women..

programme.title: 敗家仔
programme.desc: Young Leong Tsan is nothing but a spolit brat. He Bates Books and conventions but dotes on martial arts. His rich father loves him so much that handsome payments are awarded people who manage to lose gracefully to the son. Young Leong comes to think he is the best in Canton. A female impersonator, Yee Tai, rebuffs the amorous advances of one of Leong's friends. Leong comes to even the score, only to be defeated soundly by Yee Tai. Realizing that he is after all not good in kung fu, Leong stays behind with Yee Tai's operatic troupe as a coolie, hoping that Yee Tai would teach him the combat art some day..

The two is now planning seriously how to get all the valuables from the big guy. However..

programme.title: 阿郎的故事
programme.desc: Ah Long is a car racing fanatic who is in love with Ah Kar. Ignoring her mother's advice, Ah Kar decides to marry Ah Long. Tragic follows by this illegal car racing contest..

programme.title: 月黑風高
programme.desc: Michael Chow is the chief cop of Tai O, a small rural town on Hong Kong's outlying Lantau Island. When a local man turns up dead, urban hero cop Michael Wong is sent in to help out the locals... and what follows is a cultural clash that's both humorous and utterly entertaining! Wong is an SDU cop and takes to bullying the locals with tough and hard-handed ways, but his efforts only result in resentment and anger. It's Chow who gets what the odd residents of Tai O are about, and his lackadaisical attitude is just what's needed to handle the prickly locals. But it may take the skills of both men to solve this murder case! Though nominally a cop film, this unique creation is as much a comedy of cultural errors as a murder mystery.

programme.title: 目中無人
programme.desc: MA and KAU were the Senior Inspectors of Narcotics Bureau. They were smuggling with the Golden Triangle in Thailand. CHEUNG – an officer of Custom Department. CHEUNG and MA were good friend since they studied in the University. MA's group wanted to get more help in custom, he asked CHEUNG to be his partner, but CHEUNG refused. While KAU was very hasty, he killed all CHEUNG's family. Then, CHEUNG wanted to take revenge against them. However, MA and KAU made a plan to get CHEUNG into trouble. At last, CHEUNG escaped to Thailand and stayed at his aunt's house. MA and KAU knew that CHEUNG escaped to Thailand, so they tried their best to kill him, but they did not succeed..

programme.title: 大內密探零零發
programme.desc: Fat is a neglected member of 'The King's Guardian'. Kam dynasty uses an excuse to assassinate the Emperor. 'Fat' smells the trouble and go along secretly to protect the Emperor..

programme.title: 心動
programme.desc: Ho-jun is a shy youngster, more interested in his guitar than school. A chance encounter between Ho-jun and Sheo-rou leads to a first sweet taste of romance. However..

programme.title: 新仙鶴神針
programme.desc: While the world of martial arts is in probably the most peaceful period for a long while, the Tien Lung Tribe suddenly emerges with a strong military presence as if it were to conquer the warring society. As its presence begin to stir up everyone in the scene, the Court decides to order the leader of the Six Fan Gates – Cho Hung to gather the ten most esteemed tribes for a conference in an attempt to prevent any chaos or unnecessary warfare in the community..

programme.desc: 'Ghost Invasion'- Tung, who has a simple and pure mind and just started his new job, is quickly attracted by his cool but sexy boss – Sam. At the same time, he meets with his secondary schoolmate in the company – Mick. Mick always talks about women with Tung, he even sets a goal of ‘counting on Sam'. Later, Tung always meets Sam because of overtime work. Sam always changes the style and image when she comes out from washroom at night, which she turns to be seducing, charming and totally different from the one at daytime...'A Horny Ghost'- The boss of a pornographic films dubbing company is a horny man, he is accidentally killed because of a sexual harassment. Even her friends can never escape from her, any good news of her friends will be violated and changed to a bad news. The stranges.(n)

programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. programme.desc: Lam, an experienced policeman, had his quiet and beautiful life in Tung Ping Chau. He often tackled criminal cases with his supernatural power. One day, the old lady living next door came to ask him to go Hong Kong Island to get back the dead body of her daughter, a stewardess who was killed by the police as being suspected to be a drug smuggler. Lam's niece, Lin, a young country girl, was very interested in the life of Hong Kong and decided to go with Lam. At the Police Station, Lam knew that the 'Stewardess' was killed by 2 police sergeants, Yin and Miu, after a desperate struggle. Lam explained that the 'Stewardess' had actually been killed before she came back to Hong Kong. She had been turned to be a living corpse and controlled by a Japanese magician for smuggling..(n)

However, when the gangsters got the diamond, one of them intended to possess the diamond alone but was discovered by the others. They were very angry and wanted to kill him. So Zhi was involved in the case and was attacked by the three gangsters but fortunately she could escape with her tricks..(n)

programme.desc: By the early twenty centuries, there was a great disaster in Guang Xi. The myth of ghosts and plagues were overwhelmingly perplexed people in the Phoenix City. In order to ease the pain of the villagers, a medical group were commanded to stay in the Church of the Phoenix City. Unfortunately, the church was actually the home of the ghosts..(n)

programme.title: 年年有今日
programme.desc: The story took place in 1964 in Lantau Island. Yau Sing, married, was sent to Lantau Island on business purpose. There was a typhoon and the ferry service stopped. At the ferry pier, he met Waisan, who would be marrying in two weeks time. The two fell in love at first sight and spent the night together. Since they were both married to someone else and could not be together, they agreed to meet each other at the same place, on the same day every year. They did this for twenty-nine years without stopping. Then Yau Sing's wife passed away and he asked Waisan to marry him. He even threatened that if she refused, he would never see her again. But in the end, they remained as secret lovers.(n)

programme.title: 最佳拍檔
programme.desc: The Mafia is concluding a secret deal in Hong Kong when the loot to be handed over, a consignment of valuable diamonds, is stolen by someone who left a white glove. Based on this clue, the police thinks that it is the work of the infamous international thief 'White Glove' Interpol is contacted and an ace detective, Baldy, is sent from New York to investigate. He is assisted by a local woman inspector known for her toughness. They start on a wrong footing initially but grow to be very fond of one another..(n)

programme.title: 魔畫情
programme.desc: Leung Chiu Wei and Willy were cartoonists. One day when they were on the way to office, they knocked down a lady-ghost Joey Wong. Joey's spirit was thus thrown into the human world. Joey knew nothing as it was the first time she came to a mundane environment. At this time, she met another demoness – Deanie Yip. Yip and her son were sentenced to death by village people because of adultery. Yip didn't do it but nobody believed her. Yip's only hope was to make her son revive from death. Thus when Yip met Willy, she selfishly kept herself and her son inspired by Willy's human spirit. She also intended to hurt Wei the same as well. Since Joey had fallen in love with Wei, she helped Wei to get away from Yip. Joey became weaker and weaker being hurt by Wei's flourishing human vitality. Wei and Joey in fact were lovers in their previous lives..(n)

programme.title: 油尖少爺
programme.desc: Zhan's family was very rich, but his wife died early. He and his daughter Baby depended on each other. Zhan liked dancing in nightclub which his daughter opposed. Therefore, she dressed up to work in the nightclub in order to make her dad mad. A gangster had an interest in Baby, but fortunately Cong came forward to help. Baby and Cong developed feelings for each other. Baby used her wealth to help Cong with his career, but when Cong found out that his career was helped by Baby secretly, it was difficult for him to accept. How should Cong decide.(n)

programme.title: 新流氓醫生
programme.desc: University of Hong Kong graduate Situ Luo was a young, highly skilled and promising physician. Ann, a nurse in the same hospital with him, was his girlfriend. Because of work, Luo felt that he could not take care of his girlfriend, and then proposed break up to Ann. He introduced her to her long-admired friend and colleague Xi. Unexpectedly, Xi was shot dead. Only Luo was beside him before he died, so he became the biggest suspected murderer. Because of brain stimulation and loss of memory, Luo then pleaded guilty and was sentenced to prison..(n)

programme.title: 慈禧秘密生活
programme.desc: The last empress of China, CHI HEI, had dominated the country for over fifty years. Yet, her rise to power owned much to her manipulation of her beauty and sexual appeal. Prior to becoming one of the three thousand concubines chosen to serve the emperor. CHI met KUNG, younger brother of the Emperor; and they fell in love with each other. However, KUNG fled from the relationship to avoid conflicts with his brother. In order to stand out from other concubines, CHI racked her brains to design numerous creative and exciting “on-bed tricks” for the Emperor, who madly enjoyed their lovemaking. After she bore him a son, she became the first lady..(n)

programme.title: 龍跨四海
programme.desc: SHIKO is brought up in a Japanese underworld family but lives with her mother in England after her parents' separation while her elder brother TARO stays with her father BUTA. In a business trip to Paris, SHIKO meets a Chinese illegal immigrant CHIN-SHUI who can only earn his living by working for the Chinatown triads. The stepping in of SHIKO brings a tremendous change to his life. After the assassination for the triads in Paris, CHIN-SHUI flees to England and stays with his Chinese friend, FA-CHIN, who always loves SHIKO. Both SHIKO and CHIN-SHUI fall in love. The company that SHIKO works for is owned by her father BUTA. Both BUTA and TARO discovers NAKAMURI's corrupt practices in their company..(n)

programme.title: 痴情快婿
programme.desc: Leon busts an international drug ring at Singapore in a startling fight sequence that will shock even the most jaded filmgoer. From there on it's laughs galore when Leon arrives on Hong Kong with his wife to be who is then kidnapped by her own father who objects to her marrying a police officer. Frankie Chan immediately comes to the aid of his long time friend and in a series of exciting sequences they pursue Leon's missing fiance. Together they encounter her father's bumbling gangster, the vivaciously devious Sharon Kwok, and a team of deadly western agents sent to destroy them. In an explosive finale laughter takes a backseat to tension as the two battle overwhelming odds and just when all appears lost Frankie comes to the rescue.(n)

programme.title: 魔畫情
programme.desc: Leung Chiu Wei and Willy were cartoonists. One day when they were on the way to office, they knocked down a lady-ghost Joey Wong. Joey's spirit was thus thrown into the human world. Joey knew nothing as it was the first time she came to a mundane environment. At this time, she met another demoness – Deanie Yip. Yip and her son were sentenced to death by village people because of adultery. Yip didn't do it but nobody believed her. Yip's only hope was to make her son revive from death. Thus when Yip met Willy, she selfishly kept herself and her son inspired by Willy's human spirit. She also intended to hurt Wei the same as well. Since Joey had fallen in love with Wei, she helped Wei to get away from Yip. Joey became weaker and weaker being hurt by Wei's flourishing human vitality. Wei and Joey in fact were lovers in their previous lives..(n)

programme.title: 影人映語 -葛來FUN多 - 葛民輝
programme.desc: Eric Kot's hilarious image has been widely recognized by Hong Kong audience on big-screen, particularly after portrayed the character of a zany assistant in ‘Tricky Business' and an attentive killer in ‘You Shoot, I Shoot'. Having years of acting experience, he has formed his own view of how to film a comedy. Apart from being in front of cameras, he had been invited by acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar-wai to participate his work at directorial role and encountered Asian star Takeshi Kaneshiro behind-the-scene. In this episode, Eric is going to tell his stories you might not know about.(n)

programme.title: 精武門
programme.desc: Chen Zhen returns to Jingwu School to marry his fiancee. But tragic news awaits him: his master Huo Yuanjia has died, apparently from illness. He's deeply saddened and traumatised..(n)

programme.title: 雷霆特警
programme.desc: Zhao libing, an outstanding member of the Hong Kong special police force, was selected to attend special training in Seoul. During the training process, Bing met Li Ziping and Jin Yuqi, and instructor Zhang was very strict with them. After the graduation ceremony, Bing said goodbye to Qi and Ping and Cheng Zhengde sent her to the airport. They were busy with their jobs. Bing cracked a counterfeit banknote case in Hong Kong. One of the prisoners was willing to be a tainted witness and said that the mastermind was in South Korea. Bing accompanied with the Interpol to escort the tainted witness to Seoul..(n)

programme.title: 我要活下去
programme.desc: Bei Yan and Wen Zixiang grew up together and were meant to be a pair. However, Yan needed money for her grandmother who was very sick. So she married a well-to-do man in England. She had to run the restaurant for her husband and took care of their disabled daughter Ye Fan. Yet her impotent husband often abused her..(n)

programme.title: 東京攻略
programme.desc: On the marriage day of Macy, her bridegroom Takahashi disappears. She comes to Tokyo to look for him. She meets Tommy, a debt collector and Lenny, a private eye of a gangster boss..(n)

programme.title: 蜀山傳
programme.desc: Between the heaven and the Earth exist the Zu's mountain range, where live the immortals of Omei, the highest mountain of Zu, but the kingdom is in danger by Amnesia..(n)

programme.title: 逆天者
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Feng was an orphan. When he went on a date with a writer Zhi, Zhi died unexpectedly. After Feng was out of prison, his father's old friend Wei took him home to stay temporarily. One day, Feng received mysterious phone message from a woman Qi, and then he began to be deeply in love with her. Under the guidance of Wei, a love expert, Feng finally won Qi's heart. Wei suddenly arrived while Feng and Qi were having their breakfast in bed..(n)

programme.title: 衛斯理傳奇
programme.desc: Wisely, the scholar-adventurer is obsessed with myth and exotic things. Anticipating to solve the puzzle of David's absence, he went to Nepal to rescue his old buddy, who was exploring a legendary cult in the Himalayas. Disguised as a monk, Wisely's identity was revealed by the spiritual leader, a five-year old child monk. After the escape, David disappeared with the holy pearl of the cult. For the sake of the cult and the child monk, Wisely promised to retrieve the pearl. Howard Hope, the multi-national industrialist, sent his assistant Sheena to offer Wisely three million dollars for the pears. Wisely turned down the offer. From the telephone message left by David, Wisely knew that he was with Pak, the master of the Ching Society, who sponsored David's research..(n)

programme.title: 無限復活
programme.desc: Ren takes out his entire savings and persuades his best friend Sing to leave for Vegas with him. They challenge the most well respected dealer in town, and in just one round, Ren's wages is all wiped out. Ren and Sing begin their trip back to LA, but on the way their car mysteriously overturns and crashes, Sing is dead. Ren arrives home wearily to find a message on his answering machine that warns him not to go to Vegas. He decides to go back to Vegas to find out what really happened that killed Sing..(n)

programme.title: 精武門
programme.desc: Chen Zhen returns to Jingwu School to marry his fiancee. But tragic news awaits him: his master Huo Yuanjia has died, apparently from illness. He's deeply saddened and traumatised..(n)

programme.title: 色情男女
programme.desc: Leslie is a young film director whose works had poor box office. Being unemployed, he gets an offer to direct a vulgar commercial film. He has to succumb to the reality..(n)

programme.title: 蜀山傳
programme.desc: Between the heaven and the Earth exist the Zu's mountain range, where live the immortals of Omei, the highest mountain of Zu, but the kingdom is in danger by Amnesia..(n)

programme.title: 英雄本色
programme.desc: Tse-Ho works for the Triad, the deal in Tai Wan turns out to be a trap by the Taiwanese gang. A shootout ensues in which Ho and Shing flee, pursued by local law enforcement. Ho's father is killed, he pleads with Kit to forgive his brother.Ho is released from prison three years later. Remorseful and determined to start a new life, he finds work as a driver for a taxi company, run by another ex-con. Ho spots Mark during one of his shifts; in contrast to Mark's letters, he realizes that Mark has been reduced to an errand boy for Shing (who is the new leader of the Triad). During an emotional reunion, Mark asks Ho to take revenge on Shing and reclaim their positions in the organization, but Ho refuses. Shing finds Ho and presses him to come back to his organization, offering to reinstate Mark if he returns. Ho flatly refuses. Consequently, Shing begins harassing Ho in order to get him to return, including luring Kit into a trap and injuring Kit, attacking Ho's co-workers, and hav.(n)

programme.title: A計劃
programme.desc: This is Hong Kong at the turn of the century. The South China Sea is crawling with smugglers, cut-throats and pirates and none is more successful than the gang led by the notorious pirate Lo. Government forces invariably lose to Lo. Finally the Government looks the other way whenever Lo is around. Young seaman Jackie Chan, so far better known for his bar room fights, resigns from the Marine Force. He plans to stage a personal vendetta against Lo. Jackie gets the help of Samo Hung, little knowing Samo has his own axe to grind. Jackie and Samo suffer an inglorious drubbing in the hands of Lo. Jackie, now completely incensed, decides to don the uniform once again. He finds young commander Yuen Biao sympathetic to his cause but adamant against his antics..(n)

programme.title: 英雄本色III
programme.desc: The year is 1974. A young Hong Kong Chinese, Mark, travels to Saigon to make his fortune. There, he encounters a mysterious femme fatale, the lovely Kit. As he becomes more involved in her various underworld deals, a tragic romance develops. On the eve of the outbreak of war, Kit's past returns to endanger her, and Mark must risk everything for the one true love of his life..(n)

programme.title: 衛斯理傳奇

programme.title: 賭俠1999
programme.desc: King, the Con Man, is regarded as the successor of God of Gamblers. Dragon opts for gambling and approaches King, hoping to learn gambling tricks from him..(n)

programme.title: 新天龍八部之天山童姥
programme.desc: The one who solves hermit Ding's chess game will become the grand master of martial arts. A shaolin young monk must solve the complex game to forestall great calamity..(n)

programme.title: 最佳損友
programme.desc: After the death of their father, Kwai was asked to take over half of his father's properties but Fu was not willing to share. Fu then sent three pals to ruin Kwai's reputation..(n)

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: A rainstorm compelled Ling to trespass Lan Po Temple for a night. Ling meets attractive Siu Seen. Being unawareof Lit's murder, he is madly in love with Siu Seen..(n)

programme.title: 97家有囍事
programme.desc: Old Mr. Lao has three sons and the youngest one Lao Kung is his favorite. However, Kung does nothing but fool around all day long. Old Mr. Lao is very annoyed about this. The relationship between father and son is thus affected. So on Kung‘s birthday, his two brothers decide to play a joke on him. They trick him into believing he has won the lottery. Kung is so happy that he spends a tremendous amount of money. When he realizes he is in huge debt, he pretends to go insane and the whole family believes him. They take great care of him and confide in him. It is this pretence that makes Kung grows up and he and his father finally end in good terms.(n)

programme.title: 風雨同路
programme.desc: Undercover cop Cheung Long is instructed to take up the identity as convict to get acquainted to Lee Wan Fay who is a stolen goods dealer. In the course of escaping from Big Mad, an opponent of Fay, both Long and Fay grow a good feeling towards each other. When Long's supervisor wants to use Fay to bait Big Mad, Long saves Fay and tells him the truth..(n)

These stunning close encounters capture whales like you have never seen them before.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Western Australia’s Murchison GeoRegion is well known for its’ ancient landscapes and\nbrilliant skies, this is the real outback. We take a journey through a region full of stories dating back to\nthe earth’s beginning, around 4½ billion years ago.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc:
Part One of a journey along the Kamilaroi Highway, from Willow Tree to Moree, in New
South Wales, taking in The Great Divide on our way to the Great Australian Outback. Magnificent
landscapes, awesome attractions, and we meet some really cool people as we make our way through
a region which traditional owners are spiritually connected to.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Part Two of our Kamilaroi Highway road-trip starts in Lightning Ridge and wraps up in\nBourke, and we’re blessed with more sensational countryside, and the awesome stories that make\nthis area of Australia so popular. This is a part of Australia everyone needs to discover.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Flanked by three Australian States this journey re-traces part of the expedition undertaken\nby European Explorer Charles Sturt in the 1840’s, when he was looking to discover an inland sea, in\nthe very interior of the country.

programme.title: Great Aussie Road Trips 第1季
programme.desc: Central Victoria is ‘river & ranges country’, and is an easy drive out of Victoria’s capital, Melbourne. Epic scenery, outstanding natural beauty, lots of history, and down to earth hospitality, our road-trip through Central Victoria does not disappoint.

programme.title: Tasting Tasmania 第1季
programme.desc: Ben Milbourne joins his foodie friend Amy Luttrell to help cook breakfast for his friends at the Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary after having a cuddle with some of Tasmania’s unique animals. On his way down to Hobart Ben stops off at a boutique, family-owned Stefano Lubiana Winery, which overlooks the picturesque River Derwent.

programme.title: Tasting Tasmania 第1季
programme.desc: Ben Milbourne explores the infamous Salamana Market in Hobart where he speaks with local producers about their Fresh Tasmanian Produce. Ben spends his evening enjoying the Hobart nightlife.

programme.title: Growing Wild 第1季
programme.desc:
To the uninitiated, a farmer’s toil is never-ending, hard, and against the elements. To the initiated like Chris however, that’s simply a misconception. 

Nature is elegant by design, everything has its place and purpose and nothing is wasted. There are lessons to be learnt from rain cycles and forest floor debris offer enriching take-aways.

So the question is how? How do we apply these principles of nature to the green projects we bring into our non-wild, non-natural, personal spaces.

programme.title: Growing Wild 第1季
programme.desc:
To the uninitiated, a farmer’s toil is never-ending, hard, and against the elements. To the initiated like Chris however, that’s simply a misconception. 

Nature is elegant by design, everything has its place and purpose and nothing is wasted. There are lessons to be learnt from rain cycles and forest floor debris offer enriching take-aways.

So the question is how? How do we apply these principles of nature to the green projects we bring into our non-wild, non-natural, personal spaces.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this episode crane operator Nick, is called out to a very unusual job removing two old portable cabins from a recycling yard and replacing with new ones. But with each cabin weighing at least four tonnes and overhead electrical cables to negotiate this is a highly hazardous job. Seasoned recovery op Jim’s must rescue an abandoned Toyota from a live lane on the M1. Recovery op Rory visits a depot in Milton Keynes to recover an 8-ton tractor unit normally used to transport pizza. Meanwhile rescue driver Jon must tow a 44-ton bus the wrong way down a dual carriageway….(n)

programme.title: Man Eats Wild 第1季
programme.desc: Mario returns to his home land in Australia to help a friend with some wild boar pest control and catch some prehistoric fish out of a billabong…. But drama strikes and Mario finds him self in crocodile infested water plucking fish out with his bare hands…. All of these delicious bush treats are prepared of course in a termite oven which Mario makes.(n)

programme.title: Man Eats Wild 第1季
programme.sub-title: Birds Of A Feather / Duck and Pheasant

programme.title: Growing Wild 第1季
programme.desc:
The utility of plants in regulating our environment is paramount but their aesthetics shouldn’t be underestimated. The notion that we first eat with our eyes extends to our relationship with plants.

Weird and wonderful or just plain unassuming, plants seem set out to wit and to woo us, a giant frond waving our way, flowers that open only at 4 p.m. 

Further testament to the uncanny nature of nature, the personalities of plant parents seem to mirror their plant children and vice versa – a plant otaku and his ground-defying airplants, an architect and his sublime flora sculptures.

When bringing more wild into our environment, should we consider our personalities against the plant’s to better coexist? Don’t be afraid to go a little potty.(n)

偵探艾迪森 -失蹤的長毛象
programme.desc: Ms. Bell has planned to surprise her students by hiding mammoth fossils in the school sandpit for them to dig up. But the surprise is on Ms. Bell and her students when the fossils disappear – and Addison has figure out where they went.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -可疑的圓圈之謎
programme.desc: When crop circles begin appearing in Ayrton Park, Alex suspects visitors from the fourth dimension, but Addison begins sleuthing in search of a different explanation.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -瓶蓋
programme.desc: Small yet that doesn't stop our DIY geniuses from coming up with something fun.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -報紙
programme.desc: The best news is that Hepi and Briko have figured out some exciting DIY's.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -遊吟詩人和吟遊歌手
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, listening to music for entertainment is a much-appreciated pastime. Singers and musicians of that era travel round Europe singing their poetry. Famous minstrel Howler is a huge hit at a fiery banquet in his lordship's court.

programme.title: 優可 -公園督察員
programme.desc: There is an inspector in the park, and she keeps putting red stickers everywhere. It seems as if she doesn't like the park at all! The children and Yoko are on a mission to change that.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -畢爾卡積分
programme.desc: The Triplets have gotten jobs as window washers, but they think it's boring. They ask Sprinter for help. To motivate them, he makes a point system that resembles money back on Earth. But it turns out to be a very bad idea.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -里歐的新床
programme.desc: Leo is homesick, and she misses both Earth and the disgusting tree trunk that she lived in. Sprinter immediately finds her a fresh, new tree trunk to cheer her up. But to make it a good bed to sleep in, they have to make it really disgusting.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海洋汙染
programme.desc: A monster is rampaging in the ocean, and Kit and Mr. Battery decide to stop it.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海溝
programme.desc: When the bathyscaph fails during the descent, trapping Kit and Mr. Battery inside, they recall their previous troubles and how they got out of them.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -中世紀家庭生活
programme.desc: Meet a peasant family in their daily lives, back in the Middle Ages. Dove and Howler are very busy parents! Besides educating their little urchin kids, welcoming a new baby, dealing with daily home life, life for these peasant parents is eventful to say the least.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -西伯利亞之旅
programme.desc: While Zoe and Milo warm up inside, Alim suggests skating. The kids doubt it's possible in such cold. To prove them wrong, Alim takes them to Siberia. There, Sergei shows them Siberian life-permafrost, stilt houses, and melting ice for water.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -留尼旺島之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are surprised by wasps during lunch. Alim says they should be happy to see them. To explain, he takes them to Reunion Island. During a picnic, a swarm of wasps causes panic, but Zoe and Milo learn that on this island, wasps are actually a popular delicacy.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -印度之旅
programme.desc: For hamsters' day, Zoe and Milo want to surprise Alim by making confetti to throw on their little friend. But Alim knows a place on earth where people celebrate by throwing something more interesting than confetti up in the air. Our heroes land in Rajasthan, India.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -韓國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe's mum doesn't like cakes, so Zoe isn't sure what to make for her birthday. Alim suggests visiting their penfriend Kachiko, who lives in South Korea. They meet up with her on the beach.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -假新聞
programme.desc: During a workshop for their neighborhood TV channel, Penelope and Mily witness an incident. While Penelope thinks she has a scoop, Mily investigates. Is what we see always the truth.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -慶祝吧
programme.desc: So sad! This year, Juliette can't visit her Mom on the 4th of July, the United States' national holiday. Why is this holiday so important to her? Mily wants to please her friend and will discover why some dates are more important than others.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -小炸彈
programme.desc: Leo is shouting that she is exploding. What is happening to Leo? Is she joining sides with explosion-loving Boom? Everyone is glad to find out that the explosion is simply a case of passing gas.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -迷你飛毛腿
programme.desc: Sprinter has built a lot of look-a-like robots to protect Hilltown. When DiktaThor arrives he tries to fight them but quickly realises that they aren`t the real superhero. Sprinter must step in to save the day.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -尋找微乎其微的微生物
programme.desc: How can microbes be of use at a birthday party? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of microorganisms. Have hands-on fun by experimenting with yeast, and get to know Satoshi Omura, a biochemist, who discovered medicine inside miniscule microbes.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環境科學
programme.desc: How do sea animals stay warm in extreme cold? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of environmental science. Have hands-on fun by creating a blubber glove, and get to know Rachel Carson, a marine biologist and chief advocate of global environmentalism.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -會飛的貓
programme.desc: The scientist cat Edison is famous for his invention, and his latest one is a strange pair of mechanical wings: Meatball dreams of flying, graceful as a bird, and offers as volunteer to test them. Will he become the first flying cat ever.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -來吧!愛波
programme.desc: Ebb doesn't want to go to the boat yard summer party. But Bird does. Ebb smells sausages from the barbeque and ends up the first to arrive. They have a great time. Ebb and Bird over-eat and can barely get home. Flo giggles.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -停學的緊張局勢
programme.desc: The kids are suspended and grounded again. They have only one choice for redemption - disobey their parents, break into the school at night, and discover the lab before it gets destroyed.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -大野狼一敗塗地
programme.desc: During the school treasure hunt, Humpty Dumpty hides eggs and serves as MC. Rose and students are repeatedly ambushed by the Bad Wolf. After a failed showdown, Rose tries to put Humpty back together and stop the Wolf.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -童年
programme.desc: Children of noble stock receive an education in a castle environment while peasant offspring spend their youth working in the fields or at home. Daily life is busy, from a very young age. But kids never forget to have fun and goof around or playing pranks on each other.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宴會
programme.desc: Howler and Dove are invited to Lord Roach's banquet. But banquets come with all kinds of rules and regulations, exposing the greedier guests in the room! Hardened foodies, they indulge in all kinds of scheming.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -松露危機
programme.desc: What are truffles, anyway? And if they're so rare, how do we find some? Doki, Gabi, Mundi and Fico head to the Tuscany region of Italy, to borrow a comically lazy truffle hunting dog, and try to snuffle up a new truffle.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -茅廁時光
programme.desc: The Colosseum and the public baths weren't Rome's only claims to fame! Toilets, also known as latrines, never failed to amaze those who visited them, for a whole host of surprising reasons that it would be impolite to go into here..

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -努比亞弓箭手
programme.desc: In Nubia, the bow was a real passion! Precision shots, rain of arrows... For the Nubians, bow handling held no secrets. And children, even the clumsiest ones, dreamt of imitating great archers like Howler! At their own risk.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -海豚
programme.desc: Today Kristina has to perform an ultrasound on Ulysses, the dolphin's, eye. But can she train Ulysses to keep her eye open long enough to perform the vital test? Meet also Garoe, a one-year-old chimp and Dali, the emperor tamarin, who has an age-old problem.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -費城
programme.desc: Philly love: Rowing at Boathouse Row, history walk at Independence Hall, mural art with the Mural Arts Program, and pretzel twisting at Philadelphia Pretzel Factory. A week of cultural immersion with Nicole and local teens.

programme.desc: The four friends reach a dead end and, even worse, are caught by the lurking Bruno Black. Bruno gives our heroes a sobering reality check, but Hulk refuses to give up, even when all hope is lost.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -南瓜與巨龍
programme.desc: Rose accidentally turns Regal Academy into a pumpkin patch. The teachers need a rare colossal pumpkin to reverse the spell. With help from Alicia, Puss In Boots' granddaughter, Rose, Hawk, and the others must find the rare pumpkin to save the school.

programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, safety's a little shaky. So is justice! It's ‘Sheriff' Howler's job to hunt down outlaws and bring them before the judge. But the methods he uses are a trifle different from what we're used to today.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -大教堂
programme.desc: If you want a cathedral, you'd better not be in a hurry! The construction site is a village in its own right, and lasts for several generations! Foreman Howler shows us round a medieval construction site, providing us with a 101 on cathedral-building techniques.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -愛爾蘭運勢說

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And when a normal day includes alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods, you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -克羅埃西亞

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -猶他
programme.desc: Utah adventure: White water rafting near Salt Lake City, bobsled racing at Utah Olympic Park, fearless rappelling in Moab, and off-the-grid dinosaur excavation. A week of thrilling escapades with Nicole and local teens in the great state of Utah.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -洋流

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -浮冰

programme.title: 深海大探險 -失蹤

With a global perspective on the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, it captures cutting-edge trends in economic and trade exchanges, technological innovation, cultural trends, and more between China and the world. Through on-site research and interviews, the program engages in conversations with leaders from government, business, technology, and cultural sectors. Since its inception over two years ago, “Talk With Claire About Great Bay Area” has aired more than a hundred episodes of specialized interviews. programme.desc: 今集開餐推介：避風塘辣蟹，啖啖肉惹味十足! 還有椒麻脫殼瀨尿蝦，鮮香度滿分! 一間小小的人氣拉麵店，只賣兩款招牌拉麵一樣大受歡迎! 斯里蘭卡菜原來香港一樣食到，更是傳統正宗風味! 翠林辣蟹舫亞士厘道24-38號天星大廈1樓A鋪這間位於尖沙咀的辣蟹專門.(n)

programme.title: 關於早餐的一些事
programme.desc: 茶餐廳的早餐深入民心，今集請來食家劉晉和大家探討香港茶餐廳的早餐文化，一試罕見的茶餐廳名物，更會帶大家吃盡各種不同的雞蛋，怎樣煎一隻完美的蛋？為何蛋殼會有斑點？窺探挑選雞蛋背後的學問。.(n)

programme.title: 中國光大集團呈獻 : 一線搜查
健康關注組
programme.desc: 不懂得用說話去表達自己、不停重複別人的說話、說話時用詞古怪、理解能力比較低，這些看來是自閉症的病徵，原來自閉症現今已定義為一整個譜系，同樣病徵有亞氏保加症，被稱為一種高功能自閉症，這跟一般自閉症有甚麼分別？.(n)

programme.title: 黑白大廚滋味行
programme.desc: 最後一集要帶大家去朝聖黑隊師傅20強的「烤雞串之王」，在第一集時便以烤土雞以及各式雞部位串燒晉級」，他在延南洞的餐廳可是連續四年榮獲米芝蓮餐盤推薦。主廚在與米芝蓮指南的採訪中提到，他開店的初衷是希望透過他的餐廳帶大眾認識純種韓國產雞肉最真實的味道，所.(n)

programme.desc: 當你年輕的時候何曾想過要養生？同樣的問題，對彭秀慧（Kearen）、廖子妤、余香凝來說有著共同的答案，但有不同的見解。今集《自煮女人最漂亮》大談婦科痛症，余香凝面對宮寒應如何解決？廖子妤時常手腳冰冷應如何是好？.(n)

貓店長 2
programme.desc: 新手店長開新店需要準備什麼？第一件事就係要為貓打造一個舒適的空間。當Noel開店時，已第一時間尋找貓貓收養，但領養過程並不順利，最後有緣遇上多比、眨眨兩姊妹。阿丁在工作室搬遷後，打造一個舒適的環境，便接連領養了錘仔和士巴拿。.(n)

programme.title: 關於早餐的一些事
programme.desc: 英式早餐又名全日早餐，近年廣受大眾歡迎，一份早餐盛著十多種食材，到底貴在哪裡？而正宗的英式早餐又是怎樣？早餐當然不少得一杯咖啡坐陣，今集主持將會試勻各種咖啡，由最普通的即溶咖啡到精品咖啡，細看當中的底蘊。.(n)

programme.desc: 塵蟎，每個人家中都有，有說塵蟎是引發過敏、哮喘、鼻敏感等等麻煩問題的常見元兇。如果沒有辦法完全殺滅塵蟎，如何尋求治療方法，防止過敏呢？據說「塵蟎免疫療法」，是一種可以令人不再對塵蟎產生過敏反應，這種一勞永逸的治療方案，是否人人可用？.(n)

捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：失敗的官宣
programme.desc: 蔣時延剛將唐漾送回家，彭思便致電蔣時延說盛倪娜出事了。蔣時延匆匆趕往公司，原來是有人在網上發佈了盛倪娜的不雅照片，一時間成熱門搜尋。盛倪娜帳號被盜，程回也通過技術手段發現圖片是偽造的.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解3
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解3》邀請了香港觀鳥會燕子研究組燕巢普查義務統籌王學思，分享有關燕子的知識。本集以小白腰雨燕和家燕作例子，並首次利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索燕子的外貌特徵、食性、生活習性.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 《港樂‧講樂 Pop Up》繼續走入人群，讓廣東歌以貼地方式走近觀眾。今集人氣歌手吳啟洋(Phoebus)為觀眾帶來愛得小心翼翼的《漸漸地》以及失戀情歌《孤獨先生》，以真摯歌聲呈現內心世界。嘉賓主持林智樂則帶來重新演繹的彭羚經典《完全因你》，以男聲演繹女歌，展現不一樣的情感層次。. 主持. 阮頌陽. 嘉賓主持. 林智樂. 歌曲：. 《完全因你》. 《漸漸地》. 《孤獨先生.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十四集：秦川臨危受命查昀城、溪城案
programme.desc: 2009年10月和12月，溪城發生了兩宗槍殺案。武英德、曹忠恕經現場勘察研究後，提出可以確定溪城的兩宗案件和昀城兩宗案件是系列案，但遭到了溪城市局副局長顧保雄的反對。2010年10月溪城再次發生槍殺案，秦川受委於武英德，決心偵破昀城、溪城系列案.

programme.title: 中國 (第三季)
programme.desc: 為了穩定天下，攝政的周公主導了以分封制為核心的一系列自上而下的制度設計。政治日趨成熟，禮樂日漸興盛，兩大支柱的合力支撐，將周朝最終熔鑄成一個文化、經濟和政治的共同體.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第六十四集 - 跟光影玩遊戲
programme.desc: BobieLand 第六十四集-跟光影玩遊戲. 編導:蔡頌詩. 寶欣姐姐和小隊長Mika 、Jamie在草地上看書，突場，全場漆黑一片，原來園長澔天哥哥發現BobieLand停了電，當大家不知怎算好的時候，終於記起～Okie Bobie的細細小燈柱，有了它，大家可以繼續看書了。. 【嘉賓來了】. 今集請來沙畫師－海潮老師向大家介紹沙畫和沙動畫，老師亦即場教小朋友嘗試畫沙畫，猜猜小朋友畫了什麼～對，是大家最愛的Okie Bobie.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 溫暖的皮毛和羽毛讓衆多動物寶寶令人想擁入懷中，但這些華麗外衣的功能遠比表面所見更多。亮麗的色彩與鮮艷的斑紋都是大自然的隱身術，讓這些生物能於衆目睽睽之下隱身，或令暗中虎視眈眈的掠食者眼花繚亂。請與我們一起倒數十大最想擁抱、最討人喜歡的得意寶寶.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解3
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解3》邀請了香港觀鳥會燕子研究組燕巢普查義務統籌王學思，分享有關燕子的知識。本集以小白腰雨燕和家燕作例子，並首次利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索燕子的外貌特徵、食性、生活習性.

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集：杜秉文正式見家長
programme.desc: 袁歌去找杜秉文，杜秉文卻故意不理會袁歌。谷嶠去勸杜秉文。杜秉文為了獎勵谷嶠，讓谷嶠去參加行業交流會，期間才知道是有熊啟明幫忙自己才拿下合約。袁歌告訴袁父自己和杜秉文的關係，袁父催袁歌把杜秉文帶來給自己見，杜秉文又開心又緊張.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 本集將講述兩位媽媽，照顧特殊教育需要(SEN)兒子的故事。. 何媽媽的兒子熙仔小時候確診自閉症，丈夫一直不願接受。兒子其後更被確診患思覺失調，丈夫同樣不願承認。得不到另一半理解及支持，何媽媽只好跟兒子同行。一直以來，她夾在丈夫和兒子之間，獨自承受作為「照顧者」的壓力。. 後來，她自己也出現抑鬱的症狀。她告訴兒子的心理學家，開始接受若無法改變丈夫的想法，只好改變自己。近年，她在浸信會愛羣社會服務處的精神康復者家屬資源及服務中心找到同路人，大家一同分享當照顧者面對的困難，終於感到有人明白自己。. 何媽媽和熙仔的故事，也許對本集另一主角嘉嘉和洭洭有所啟發。就讀小四的洭洭是專注力不足/過度活躍症(ADHD)和自閉症譜系障礙患者，由母親嘉嘉獨力撫養。自年少時已經確診抑鬱症的嘉嘉，經常擔心自己無法獨力照顧洭洭，心中很多焦慮和自責，難以抒發龐大壓力。. 懂事的洭洭作為小家屬，明白母親有時會傷心難過。他有自己一套開解母親的方法，雖然未必是最好的方式，但經過社工的協助，洭洭逐漸了解媽媽的需要。反之，嘉嘉見證着洭洭的成長，也學懂欣賞自己，肯定自己作為母親的價值.

programme.sub-title: 第十七集：馬魁妻子暈倒家中
programme.desc: 姚玉玲騎自行車時，因前輪無故脫落而摔倒。原來，車是刷上新漆的二手自行車，姚玉玲生氣。馬魁發現妻子昏迷不醒，急忙送她到醫院。大夫跟馬魁說出馬魁妻子其實有末期肺癌，要他有所準備。馬魁聽聞震驚，問妻子為什麼要隱瞞，馬燕泣不成聲。馬魁悲痛地去辦理住院手續.

programme.title: 南來北往
programme.sub-title: 第十八集：汪新和馬魁轉為刑警
programme.desc: 汪新和馬魁轉為刑警後，馬魁為了省飯錢，用電爐煮麵條，結果導緻小旅館斷電。老闆找上門要沒收電爐，馬魁找藉口把人打發走。兩人找到目擊證人，那人提供了嫌疑人的畫像、斷了一根手指的關鍵特徵以及嫌疑人的住址。師徒倆剛坐上前往目的地的大客車，就發現嫌犯也在車上.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第六十五集 - 跟光影玩遊戲
programme.desc: BobieLand 第六十五集-跟光影玩遊戲. 編導:蔡頌詩. 眾人在讚賞Okie Bobie的小燈柱在停電的一晚發揮了作用，Okie Bobie告訴大家已把小燈柱捐了去社區中心，因為他們更有需要。原來一枝以為不起眼的物件，會為其他人帶來希望。說著說著，bobieLand又突然停了電，今次，輪到Okie Bobie忘記交電費…. 【玩轉星期五】. 今集，八位小朋友分成四組，分別是海盜船隊、咖啡杯隊。遊戲分為三個關卡，第一關：輪流將紙杯吹入紅色框；第二關：Kevin哥哥負責拋波，隊員要拉起接球框接波；第三關：利用兩枝長棍，跟據遊戲咭嘅指示，將顏色波夾到相應顏色嘅杯上面.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 溫暖的皮毛和羽毛讓衆多動物寶寶令人想擁入懷中，但這些華麗外衣的功能遠比表面所見更多。亮麗的色彩與鮮艷的斑紋都是大自然的隱身術，讓這些生物能於衆目睽睽之下隱身，或令暗中虎視眈眈的掠食者眼花繚亂。請與我們一起倒數十大最想擁抱、最討人喜歡的得意寶寶.

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第二十七集：你又撤回了甚麼見不得人的消息
programme.desc: 互聯網技術精英KB發佈視頻，證明盛倪娜是被盜號了，盛倪娜不雅門事件終於真相大白。而盛倪娜一直心存疑惑，素不相識的KB為甚麼要提供協助。唐漾收到一大束花，想都沒想就給自己的男朋友拍去認證照，誰知打開卡片一看，竟然是宋璟送的.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 麥婆婆與胡伯無兒無女，一直只有二人共同生活，相濡以沫。直至大坑西拆遷消息來臨，二人為尋找新居奔波煩腦之際，麥婆婆突然在街上暈倒。. 年近九十歲胡伯獨力尋找新居、搬家，更要照顧跌傷腳後無力自理的麥婆婆，二人漸明白長此下去不是辦法。胡伯找到環境合適的安老院，麥婆婆掙扎苦思半年後，終下定決心到院舍入住。胡伯堅持每天探望，麥婆婆日漸適應院舍生活，同時接受物理治療等院舍服務，安老院亦不時舉辦護老新產品推廣活動，發現軟餐發展亦令老年人生活重拾姿彩。. 二人重新找到生活等節奏。大坑西重建在即，二人重遊勾起半生回憶，對將來亦重燃寄望.

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.desc: 第五集蘇麗珊/安多酚彩妝. 〈跑者愛分享〉－蘇麗珊. 跑步要打卡是常識吧！兩位美女梁諾妍（Inez）與蘇麗珊（Cecilia），由西環跑到大口環，邊聊邊笑邊拍照。她們經過海濱長廊、大學校園、泳棚，實行來一場「動態冥想」。Cecilia更分享了她跑步的感想：「我覺得跑步畀我最大樂趣係辛苦！」. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－Zone 2 訓練是什麼？. 你以為「跑得慢」就一定無效？其實，透過Zone 2訓練，以最大心率約60-70%的輕鬆心率範圍運動，身體便會高效燃燒脂肪，提升基礎代謝與耐力。節目中會教你簡單計算方法，並示範如何靠感覺—「能輕鬆說話、不感吃力」—去掌握訓練強度，助你跑得更輕鬆、更持久！. 〈安多酚彩妝〉. 女跑團團長林茵茵，創立了香港最美麗自信的「誘騙集團」？她凝聚一群熱愛跑步的女性每月一跑，又自費出版女生跑步小誌，宣揚跑步的強大力量。跑步帶來的安多酚，就是她們最自然動人的美麗彩妝.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 東華三院旗下營運的第一間社企餐廳，今年迎來15歲生日。由實驗，試行，開張到擴張，這些年來，讓大眾了解到社企不用靠光環，也能靠實力取勝。他們的烘焙工房、餐廳、麵包店，招聘超過六成殘疾員工。他們能發揮才能之餘，也能享受工作的每一刻.

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第十五集：昀城、溪城案另有疑兇
programme.desc: 2011年，秦川到省廳刑偵總隊擔任副總隊長。趙飛提供的新線索顯示在逃犯胡中興有重大作案嫌疑。秦川認為一方面要徹查兇手在溪城逃跑的公交沿線視頻，另一方面亦要到嵐江市胡中興犯案的地方作勘查。經一番研究後，秦川覺得胡中興並不是兇手，決定重新定立偵查方向.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第二十集：雷公大春接連犧牲
programme.desc: 三排戰士奮戰至最後，李大耕用生命摧毀美軍旗幟。千里等人奪取美軍運兵車南下，途中遇上美軍，並激烈交火。大春懷抱集束手榴彈跳下車，以身炸毀坦克。雷公跟千里說起抗日期間的悲痛往事。為掩護戰友，雷公駕車引開美軍火力，最終壯烈犧牲.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集：馮辛講述三連炸橋事跡
programme.desc: 美軍堅決守住水壩橋，七連埋伏準備炸橋。春生帶來重要情報後犧牲，萬里偷偷放走春生的戰馬。老肖發現瀕死的橋樑專家馮辛。原來三連之前跟馮辛研究後，揭示炸橋必須從水壩房下的檢修梯去炸毀橋墩，三連決定對水壩橋發動進攻，並留下戰士保護馮辛.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 做人當然應該合乎「仁義道德」，但竟然亦都有人認為「厚顏無恥」、「黑心無情」是古代英雄豪傑的致勝關鍵。二十世紀初，思想家李宗吾提出「厚黑學」，寫出對自古以來成功人士的反思。運用「厚黑學」，是否真的可以加速達至成功呢？. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 蕭欣浩(大學講師). 吳沚默(作者、編劇). #厚黑學#厚顏無恥#黑心無情#成功反思#學人沙龍.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
學人沙龍
programme.desc: 提起敦煌，大家會想到國家歷史名城和石窟。千幾年前，古人會在懸崖開山鑿洞，而且一鑿就是一千六百幾年。莫高窟不單是一個石窟，更是中國建築史上最長的一封情書。本集節目我們來《透視敦煌建築》，遊覽一下這個充滿神秘色彩的地方。. 主持：. 潘浩倫(建築師). 董正綱(建築師). 陳元敬(園境師). 何培斌(香港中文大學榮休教授). #莫高窟#石窟#洞窟#敦煌研究#粱思成.

programme.title: 運動教室31 (第2季)
programme.sub-title: 運動教室31 (第2季) 第一集
programme.desc: 為大家介紹拳擊及滑浪風帆的入門知識.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈 : 粵劇 龍鳳爭掛帥
programme.desc: 《演藝盛薈》帶來粵劇《龍鳳爭掛帥》：上官雲龍與司徒文鳳同為漢朝大將：雲龍平南蠻有功，文鳳則剿滅西遼。二人雖互相傾慕，但各恃功績，互不相讓。還鄉途中，二人再起爭執，令漢帝左右為難，心生一計：封文鳳為御妹，雲龍為一字並肩王，賜金殿成婚。時北狄又再入侵中原，雲龍、文鳳即趕往校場爭奪帥印。出戰期間，雲龍戰況不利，文鳳率兵解圍，並破北狄，二人和好團圓。粵劇《龍鳳爭掛帥》由香港梨園舞台主辦，杜詠心飾演上官雲龍，林子青飾演司徒文鳳。. 演出. 杜詠心 林子青. 關凱珊 梁小飛. 郭啟煇 文雪裘. 香港梨園舞台成立於2011年，旨在弘揚香港粵劇，令此傳統本土文化得以傳揚，同時提供更多的表演機會予新一輩粵劇演員。. 杜詠心就讀於香港中文大學中醫學系。隨李龍及何孟良學藝，僅四歲便首次踏台板，常參與各劇團演出，合作演員有李龍、尹飛燕、南鳳、阮兆輝、新劍郎及廖國森等。. 林子青師承許堅信、鄭文瑛、劉洵。學藝十年，專工花旦.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
《科學 ∙創未來3》
programme.sub-title: 第六集 《大獎周活動回顧》
programme.desc: 一年一度的科學界盛會，未來科學大獎頒典禮第三度在香港完滿舉行。三項大獎--生命科學獎、物質科學獎、數學及計算機科學獎，順利頒贈予七位科學家。. 一如往年，陪隨頒獎典禮而來的大獎周活動，雲集了來自世界各地的科學界精英，包括幾位諾貝爾獎獲獎者，在一連五日的科技峰會、科學論壇、亞洲青年科學家會議等活動，聚首一堂，互相砥礪、互相交流。. 為了讓科學普及到各層面、啟迪年輕人，大會舉辦了多場由獲獎科學家主持的科普活動，分享他們的科研之路，讓青少年和市民大眾近距離接觸科學.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 吳祉昊Marco出生數個月後就被發現弱聽，要戴上助聽器才能聽得到外面的世界，現在與人溝通需要很專注地留意對方的嘴唇。2023年時Marco取得在意大利舉行的世界聾人先生小姐大賽冠軍，他在社交媒體總結自己的感想：「盡力咁做好每件事，因為我知道嗰一刻我代表緊香港」。. 脫下禮服之後，Marco繼續學業，亦開始作新嘗試，他在一套講述聾人故事的電影中擔任其中一個主角，親身演繹聾人在主流社會中的遭遇。在介紹這套電影的場合，他與其他專業演員一齊出席，得到觀眾的讚賞；在今屆金像獎提名名單，Marco的演出更入圍最佳新演員，得到進一步認同。. 他自己又會如何看這些發展，會對演員之路有甚麼憧憬?在他眼中，聽障人士的遭遇在現實世界和電影世界有甚麼分別呢?今集主持富爸爸會和Marco談談心中理想.

programme.title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團 - 北京及山東
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 為人民服務
programme.sub-title: 為人民服務 - 政府飛行服務隊 - H175 直升機模擬飛行訓練器

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 港隊空手道（型）代表近年在國際賽屢創佳績，不但於2020年東京奧運歷史性獲得女子組銅牌，更登上世界排名第一，開始備受注目。. 唱作歌手鄭俊弘Fred雖然有著廣為人知的好歌喉，但他的武術運動員身份卻鮮為人知。從小練習南拳與蔡李佛拳的他首次學習以速度、力量及平衡力缺一不可的空手道（型），如何為他打開一個嶄新的武術世界.

programme.title: 我親愛的 Donovan
programme.sub-title: 第三集：Donovan邀請Pam成為經理人
programme.desc: 為籌外公手術費，Pam成為Donovan的經理人。首日工作挑戰重重，兩人在扶持中關係拉近。Donovan不為人知的創傷在保護Pam後爆發，陷入恐慌。Pam未追問緣由，只以擁抱安慰。彼此的脆弱，讓兩顆心靠得更近.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 為人民服務
programme.sub-title: 為人民服務 - 政府飛行服務隊 - H175 直升機模擬飛行訓練器

programme.title: 周末大電影 : 英雄本色
programme.desc: 宋子豪(狄龍飾)和亞 Mark(周潤發飾)是黑社會沙煲兄弟,而子豪的親弟子傑(張國榮飾)卻是警務人員。故子豪必須生活於兩種身份中,一次子豪到台灣交易偽鈔時被當地黑幫伏擊,出賣他的人正是他看重的亞成。知悉內情的阿 Mark 隻身到台灣替子豪復仇,卻被子彈所傷,成了跛子。子豪在台灣服刑三年,回到香港後希望從新做人,但子傑不諒解他.

programme.title: 盛事傳城
programme.desc: #ddHK自2018年起舉行，將不同社區打造成充滿特色的新興旅遊熱點，成為了深受歡迎的創意文旅項目。全新活動以「遊合創意 x 探索無限」為主題，以創意元素融合荃灣及沙頭角在地的文化、古蹟及自然美景，於2024年12月12日至2025年2月14日帶領遊人發掘這兩個社區的獨有特色.

programme.title: 香港之味
programme.sub-title: 第七集 - 家國香港：時光之味
programme.desc: 香港美食的根是從內地過去的。廣府菜、客家菜、潮州菜首先隨著大批粵人入港而成為香港本地菜色，緊接著內地其他各省民眾湧入，帶來了本幫菜、寧波菜、徽菜、川菜、湘菜、京菜等，這些被統稱為外江菜。. 本集由一碗雲南米線引爆香港年輕人喜愛的潮流，拉開序幕，解構帶有地域屬性的內地美食如何成了香港人重要的飲食文化之一，從保留原汁原味料理方式，一解鄉愁的經典杭州菜“天香樓”等，到現在的“米線”，內地的美食在香港如何引領風騷，影響一代又一代的香港人的味蕾的“同頻共振”.

programme.title: 悅讀憲法
programme.sub-title: 民生福祉：憲法與社會的關聯
programme.desc: 保障人民福祉是《憲法》的核心精神。《憲法》第四十五條規定，公民在年老、疾病或喪失勞動能力時，有權獲得國家與社會的物質幫助。本集以「社會民生」為題，探討《憲法》如何構建完善的社會保障制度，關懷長者生活需要。近年不少香港長者選擇移居大灣區退休，節目走訪佛山一間安老院舍，了解港人長者之退休生活，探討長者如何在制度保障與社區關懷中安享晚年，展現《憲法》以人民為本、保障民生的核心價值.

programme.title: 有葯
programme.desc: 未來宴即將開始，眾多穿越者集中在都城。拓荒者頭目焦嬌然告訴左李二人，皇上對待穿越者的真實態度與表面不同，他們實為受害者。賢妃發起“越獄”，卻發現皇帝用穿越者做人體實驗。左雲起偽裝成平民，秘密將拓荒組消息帶給樓主.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 冬節、聖誕剛剛過去，新年將至，不少人都會和親友聚餐，也比平日稍稍放縱飲食，然而過量飲食除了令體重增加之外，亦可能會引起胃脹、消化不良等腸胃問題。而高熱量、高脂、高糖的飲食，亦會增加患上脂肪肝的風險。. 本集請來註冊營養師，跟節目主持胡志遠醫生(腸胃肝臟科專科)，一起分享節日飲食貼士，以及拆解邪惡飲食的陷阱。. 主持：羅鈺文、胡志遠醫生. 嘉賓：林思為(澳洲註冊營養師).

programme.title: 香港故事 - 尾巴會說話
programme.desc: 2023年一個夏天，一隻貓bb突然出現在中學走廊。路過的同學立即找老師幫忙救起貓貓，並把貓貓命名為「柚子」。學校為此成立貓舍，並同時領養「大眼妹」和「三花」兩隻貓貓，三隻貓貓從此化身為貓老師，為一眾師生上了生命的一課.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 澳門雙行線
programme.sub-title: 第十二集 山與海 深情味
programme.desc: 澳門人餐桌上的蔬菜、水果、生鮮，幾乎都是從內地的山水之間匯聚而來。澳門依偎在山海之間，就像山與海是血脈的相連、是親情的牽掛、是相互的愛戀。本集我們將循着山的擔當與海的包容，見證一段雙向奔赴的精彩.

programme.title: 有葯
programme.desc: 未來宴即將開始，眾多穿越者集中在都城。拓荒者頭目焦嬌然告訴左李二人，皇上對待穿越者的真實態度與表面不同，他們實為受害者。賢妃發起“越獄”，卻發現皇帝用穿越者做人體實驗。左雲起偽裝成平民，秘密將拓荒組消息帶給樓主.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今次會去學習鄂霍次克地區小清水町的牛蒡種植。這是一片旱田農業與酪農業皆發展蓮勃的地區，而處理土壤的技術亦令人驚嘆。我們學習如何人手掘牛蒡，並觀察如果用機器收割。其後亦品嚐了農民烹調的牛蒡菜式.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.sub-title: (A) 小仙女屋 (B) 機械人緋緋與機械人彼得
programme.desc: (A) 緋緋同彼得搭建小仙女屋來吸引春天小仙女出現。但小仙女吵醒了鄰居，他們決定要為小仙女找一個更好的家。. (B) 緋緋和彼得嘗試當發明家，創造了機械人美美 — 一個懂得活動、說話和執拾的機械人。但機械人美美失控，反而把家裏弄得更混亂。幸好，緋緋和彼得還有執屋的後備計劃：自己扮作機械人來執屋。. . 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2020年10月4日 星期日 上午9時30分 (網上重溫) 至 2021年10月3日 星期日. (A) Pinkalicious and Peter build a fairy house to attract the Springtime Fairies. But when the fairies turn out to be noisy roommates, they decide it's probably best if they find the fairies a better home. . (B) Pinkalicious and Peter try their hand at being inventors and create Robotta, a robot that can move, talk and most importantly, clean. But when Robotta malfunctions, the house becomes messier than ever. Fortunately, Pinkalicious and Peter have a backup solution to make cleaning more fun: Pretend to be robots while doing it!. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2020.10.4 SUN 9:30am (On-line Catch-up) Till 2021.10.3 SUN.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.sub-title: (A) 度宿派對 (B) 非常狗狗
programme.desc: (A) 緋緋在家舉行紅粉公主度宿派對，但她的朋友既想念自己的家，又怕黑，不想在緋緋的家度宿。幸好，緋緋和朋友幻想有一條叫吉吉的噴射火龍保護他們.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.sub-title: 日本 - 電子都市東京
programme.desc: 來到日本東京，不用很久就會明白自己「已經不再在堪薩斯州了」。這個大都會就像一場感官的盛宴：有閃亮耀眼的霓虹燈光、彈珠遊戲場的高頻聲響、讓人有歷奇經驗的美食、以至實驗性質、極不常見的音樂種類。此集《音樂旅人》初嚐東京的文化鮮味，過程之中的發現充滿驚喜，J-POP流行曲的古怪風格，一位日本爵士樂大師的怪癖，都令人難以忘懷。我們也約見了搖滾結他巨星，以及一位幽默風趣的嘻哈說唱歌手。這些奪目有趣的人物，一同造就了東京成為全世界最偉大的城市之一。旅程之中，我們還吃了大碗拉麵，喝過最高級的清酒，偶爾還吃到章魚燒。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月8日 星期二晚，10時30分 When visiting Tokyo, it does not take long to realize “you're not in Kansas anymore”. The massive metropolis offer a feast for the senses: blinding neon, the bleeps and blips of Pachinko parlors, adventurous cuisine and music that is experimental, animated, and sometimes, just plain unusual. On this episode of Music Voyager we get a taste of the cultural umami that is Tokyo, and it is voyage of discovery filled with surprises you will never forget. From the outlandish fashion of J-Pop, the surprising pastime of a Japanese jazz giant, Tokyo’s rock guitar superstar and a humorous hip-hop freestyler, we meet the colorful characters that make Tokyo one of the world’s greatest cities. Our journey is powered by ample bowls of delicious ramen noodles, first-class shots of sake and the occasional octopus ball. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.8 TUE 10:30pm.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.desc: 我們的旅程，從五光十色的東京來到日本東北地區，這個傳統豐富深厚的區域，曾於二零一一年遭受地震及海嘯摧毁。我們很榮幸得到兩位極受崇敬的日本作曲家——大友良英及坂本龍一——邀請，來參加由他們籌組帶領的一個高中生管弦樂團的現場演出。我們探索仙台的海岸線，又與漁民、學生、音樂人以至滑浪者訪談，他們說話中所展現的復原韌力與樂觀精神，再次印證日本人的不敗熱血。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月8日 星期二晚，11時00分 From bedazzling Tokyo we journey to the region of Tohoku, an area rich with tradition that was devastated by the earthquake and tsunami of 2011. We are invited by Yoshihide Otomo and Riuchi Sakamoto, two of Japan’s most respected and cutting-edge composers, to experience first hand a concert for healing and hope they are leading with an ensemble of local high school students. We explore the coastline near Sendai, visiting with fisherman, students, musicians and even local surfers, whose words of resilience and optimism offers inspiration and confirms the indomitable spirit of the Japanese people. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.8 TUE 11:00pm.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: In May 2025, Harvard University in the United States was barred by the government from admitting foreign students from around the world and was instructed to transfer its currently enrolled foreign students to other institutions, an incident that attracted widespread international attention. For a long time, prestigious universities in the United Kingdom and the United States have been the top study destinations pursued by students worldwide. Overseas education consultants note that, as traditional elite universities face political and economic uncertainties, Hong Kong has emerged as another highly regarded study hotspot.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: The Great Monkey King of Shing Mun
programme.desc: Established in 1977, Shing Mun Country Park is one of the early-established country parks in Hong Kong. It encompasses Tai Mo Shan, Tso Shan, and Cham Shan, and features attractions such as Shing Mun Reservoir and Waterside Paperbarks. . The park is abundant with lush vegetation, offering a diverse and rich ecosystem for exploration. Visitors can admire various butterfly species while hiking to the mountain peaks and encounter charming freshwater fish in the streams of Tai Shing Stream. . However, the true rulers of Shing Mun are the monkeys that inhabit the mountains. There are at least four recognized troops of monkeys within Shing Mun Country Park. In this episode, guided by experts, the host learns about the monkeys' habits through observation from a distance and discovers the secrets of coexistence between humans and monkeys on the mountains.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集：七連在水壩橋上發動進攻
programme.desc: 三連戰士奮戰時，馮辛冒險通知談子為美軍動向，談子為決心拼死炸毀水壩橋。面對敵軍的重火力，戰士們接連犧牲，馮辛也差點喪命。老肖與千里等人合力策劃攻擊，布認命鑽進了美軍的坦克，七連最終在坦克掩護下成功登上橋面.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：女巫舞者
programme.desc: 普契尼被譽為19世紀末和20世紀初，意大利最具代表性的歌劇作曲家之一，他的《杜蘭朵》、《波希米亞人》、《托斯卡》、《蝴蝶夫人》等作品，是當今世界上經常演出的歌劇，深入人心！而《女巫舞者》是他的歌劇處女作，《演藝盛薈.開放舞台》特別搜羅為觀眾送上。. 歌劇《女巫舞者》是根據一個古老的德國傳說編寫。故事發生在德國的黑森林，羅拔圖和安娜訂婚，村民都為他們慶賀。在婚禮前，羅拔圖必須前往美因茲領取一筆遺產，安娜擔心羅拔圖可能會不忠，懇求他留下，羅拔圖便保證會忠誠歸來。後來羅拔圖還是迷戀別的女人，令安娜傷心而死，安娜的父親古烈摩便請求女巫幽靈為女兒報仇。當羅拔圖愧疚回歸，女巫舞者圍著他起舞，安娜的鬼魂亦在其中，迫使羅拔圖跳舞至死故事結局淒美。歌劇片段由眾樂樂提供.

programme.title: 香港之味
programme.sub-title: 第八集 - 家國香港：團圓的味道
programme.desc: 香港人是如何定義“家”這個概念的？. 香港人的年夜飯，被稱為“團年”，又稱“圍爐”，起源于古人皆圍著爐子吃飯。愛玩“諧音梗”的香港人，年夜飯上的每道菜都要討個順口吉利:髮菜蠔豉寓意財源滾滾、開市大吉，雜蔬炒丁的“丁財兩旺”，魚丸、蝦丸、肉丸組成的“三元及第”，少不了的年年有餘，加上芝麻製成的煎堆，就有了“煎堆轆轆，金銀滿屋”。當然，還有“步步高升”的年糕。. 重要的時刻，食物也滿含深意，農曆新年，無論文化的融合與流變，餐桌上總是那樣熟悉的味道，圍坐的人，總是血脈親人。闔家團圓、豐衣足食、盆滿缽滿的各式佳餚，以及分享美食的熱鬧氣氛，不僅可以滿足口腹之欲，更是安撫人間至情的溫暖慰藉.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 牛奶好味又有益，可以飲用之餘，又是一種百搭的食材。今集「識食專員」奧米會去中山一個乳牛體驗農場，學習擠牛奶的技巧，又可以一嚐新鮮牛奶的滋味。回到廚房，廚師Mabel設計了一個健康版炒牛奶，仿如綻放的花，更請來中大醫學院院長趙偉仁教授以其嶺南畫派的造詣，即席為菜式畫龍點睛。. 主持：鄭萃雯(Karen)、Mabel Ho. 嘉賓：趙偉仁教授(香港中文大學醫學院院長).

programme.title: 有葯
programme.desc: 未來宴期間，皇帝宴請穿越者。賢妃通過菜品向樓主傳遞「雪死」消息，樓主決心與皇帝決裂。豫王因失去李克終止毒殺計畫，卻收到李克的神秘消息。皇帝得知拓荒組存在，試探樓主，樓主赴詹城談判。豫王與拓荒組接觸，堅持親手殺皇帝，李克震驚.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: In May 2025, Harvard University in the United States was barred by the government from admitting foreign students from around the world and was instructed to transfer its currently enrolled foreign students to other institutions, an incident that attracted widespread international attention. For a long time, prestigious universities in the United Kingdom and the United States have been the top study destinations pursued by students worldwide. Overseas education consultants note that, as traditional elite universities face political and economic uncertainties, Hong Kong has emerged as another highly regarded study hotspot.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (英文版)
programme.sub-title: The Great Monkey King of Shing Mun
programme.desc: Established in 1977, Shing Mun Country Park is one of the early-established country parks in Hong Kong. It encompasses Tai Mo Shan, Tso Shan, and Cham Shan, and features attractions such as Shing Mun Reservoir and Waterside Paperbarks. . The park is abundant with lush vegetation, offering a diverse and rich ecosystem for exploration. Visitors can admire various butterfly species while hiking to the mountain peaks and encounter charming freshwater fish in the streams of Tai Shing Stream. . However, the true rulers of Shing Mun are the monkeys that inhabit the mountains. There are at least four recognized troops of monkeys within Shing Mun Country Park. In this episode, guided by experts, the host learns about the monkeys' habits through observation from a distance and discovers the secrets of coexistence between humans and monkeys on the mountains.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.sub-title: 日本 - 電子都市東京
programme.desc: 來到日本東京，不用很久就會明白自己「已經不再在堪薩斯州了」。這個大都會就像一場感官的盛宴：有閃亮耀眼的霓虹燈光、彈珠遊戲場的高頻聲響、讓人有歷奇經驗的美食、以至實驗性質、極不常見的音樂種類。此集《音樂旅人》初嚐東京的文化鮮味，過程之中的發現充滿驚喜，J-POP流行曲的古怪風格，一位日本爵士樂大師的怪癖，都令人難以忘懷。我們也約見了搖滾結他巨星，以及一位幽默風趣的嘻哈說唱歌手。這些奪目有趣的人物，一同造就了東京成為全世界最偉大的城市之一。旅程之中，我們還吃了大碗拉麵，喝過最高級的清酒，偶爾還吃到章魚燒。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月8日 星期二晚，10時30分 When visiting Tokyo, it does not take long to realize “you're not in Kansas anymore”. The massive metropolis offer a feast for the senses: blinding neon, the bleeps and blips of Pachinko parlors, adventurous cuisine and music that is experimental, animated, and sometimes, just plain unusual. On this episode of Music Voyager we get a taste of the cultural umami that is Tokyo, and it is voyage of discovery filled with surprises you will never forget. From the outlandish fashion of J-Pop, the surprising pastime of a Japanese jazz giant, Tokyo’s rock guitar superstar and a humorous hip-hop freestyler, we meet the colorful characters that make Tokyo one of the world’s greatest cities. Our journey is powered by ample bowls of delicious ramen noodles, first-class shots of sake and the occasional octopus ball. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.8 TUE 10:30pm.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.desc: 我們的旅程，從五光十色的東京來到日本東北地區，這個傳統豐富深厚的區域，曾於二零一一年遭受地震及海嘯摧毁。我們很榮幸得到兩位極受崇敬的日本作曲家——大友良英及坂本龍一——邀請，來參加由他們籌組帶領的一個高中生管弦樂團的現場演出。我們探索仙台的海岸線，又與漁民、學生、音樂人以至滑浪者訪談，他們說話中所展現的復原韌力與樂觀精神，再次印證日本人的不敗熱血。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月8日 星期二晚，11時00分 From bedazzling Tokyo we journey to the region of Tohoku, an area rich with tradition that was devastated by the earthquake and tsunami of 2011. We are invited by Yoshihide Otomo and Riuchi Sakamoto, two of Japan’s most respected and cutting-edge composers, to experience first hand a concert for healing and hope they are leading with an ensemble of local high school students. We explore the coastline near Sendai, visiting with fisherman, students, musicians and even local surfers, whose words of resilience and optimism offers inspiration and confirms the indomitable spirit of the Japanese people. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.8 TUE 11:00pm.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 吳祉昊Marco出生數個月後就被發現弱聽，要戴上助聽器才能聽得到外面的世界，現在與人溝通需要很專注地留意對方的嘴唇。2023年時Marco取得在意大利舉行的世界聾人先生小姐大賽冠軍，他在社交媒體總結自己的感想：「盡力咁做好每件事，因為我知道嗰一刻我代表緊香港」。. 脫下禮服之後，Marco繼續學業，亦開始作新嘗試，他在一套講述聾人故事的電影中擔任其中一個主角，親身演繹聾人在主流社會中的遭遇。在介紹這套電影的場合，他與其他專業演員一齊出席，得到觀眾的讚賞；在今屆金像獎提名名單，Marco的演出更入圍最佳新演員，得到進一步認同。. 他自己又會如何看這些發展，會對演員之路有甚麼憧憬?在他眼中，聽障人士的遭遇在現實世界和電影世界有甚麼分別呢?今集主持富爸爸會和Marco談談心中理想.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第八十六集 - 「好媽媽 別咆哮」
programme.desc: BobieLand 第八十六集-「好媽媽別咆哮」. 編導:蔡少傑. 子樂剛開學，已經多次遲到，更比老師約見家長。他擔心被媽媽責罰，BobieLand的朋友們各自獻計，最後園長澔天提出搞笑主意找人扮演子樂媽媽去見老師。究竟誰人是最適合人選⋯⋯. 【故事時間】「咆哮的媽媽」. 今個星期邀請到繪本中主角-圖媽媽和兒子圖圖親自和大家分享故事中母子二人的日常生活。. 故事有不少衝突，究竟誰是誰非？Okie Bobie與一眾小朋友能否化解圖媽媽與圖圖的衝突呢？. 【冷知識】. 園長Sarah姐姐發現「媽媽」一詞在世界各地不同語言系的發音都非常相似？何解呢？. Wheel 仔竟然知道答案.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.sub-title: (A) 看不見的樂隊 (B) 緋緋最好的禮物
programme.desc: (A) 紅粉村巡遊舉行當天，銀樂隊的所有隊員卻都身體不適！幸好，緋緋和她的朋友願意代替他們表演。但有一個問題—他們沒有樂器！. (B) 今天是爸爸的生日，緋緋想送他一份最棒的禮物，但她不知道送什麼好，她決定先由包禮物的花紙開始。可是當爸爸回到家裏時，她還是只預備了花紙。. . 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2020年10月18日 星期日 上午9時30分 (網上重溫) 至 2021年10月17日 星期日. (A) It's the day of the Pinkville Parade and the whole marching band has gotten sick! Luckily, Pinkalicious and her friends eagerly volunteer to perform in their stead. There's just one small problem…they don't have any instruments!. (B) It's Daddy's birthday and Pinkalicious wants to get him the most pinkatastic gift ever. She just doesn't know what that gift should be … she decides to start with the wrapping paper. But when Daddy gets home, that's all that's done. . programme.desc: 吳祉昊Marco出生數個月後就被發現弱聽，要戴上助聽器才能聽得到外面的世界，現在與人溝通需要很專注地留意對方的嘴唇。2023年時Marco取得在意大利舉行的世界聾人先生小姐大賽冠軍，他在社交媒體總結自己的感想：「盡力咁做好每件事，因為我知道嗰一刻我代表緊香港」。. 脫下禮服之後，Marco繼續學業，亦開始作新嘗試，他在一套講述聾人故事的電影中擔任其中一個主角，親身演繹聾人在主流社會中的遭遇。在介紹這套電影的場合，他與其他專業演員一齊出席，得到觀眾的讚賞；在今屆金像獎提名名單，Marco的演出更入圍最佳新演員，得到進一步認同。. 他自己又會如何看這些發展，會對演員之路有甚麼憧憬?在他眼中，聽障人士的遭遇在現實世界和電影世界有甚麼分別呢?今集主持富爸爸會和Marco談談心中理想.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 尾巴會說話
programme.desc: 二十年的璀璨攝影生涯，蔡敏亮說敵不過一場遺憾。攝影師蔡敏亮（CM LEUNG）曾經定格無數人生最閃耀的時刻:新郎新娘的淚水、親友的笑容、愛與承諾的永恆，令他得到過不少國際與本地婚禮攝影獎項。然而五年前，兩隻愛犬的相繼離世，他發現千萬次快門聲中，卻缺了與牠們共處的畫面。那份「來不及」，在他心中開了一道無法癒合的傷口，也點燃了他人生最重要的一次轉身，他決定要為每個「來不及」作證。. 蔡敏亮決定走進被時間遺忘的角落，開始為病重、年邁、即將踏上彩虹橋的寵物進行家庭照義拍服務。他的鏡頭，特別停駐在唐狗身上——這些在城市邊緣默默遊走的生命。牠們沒有血統證書、沒有高貴的名字，被貼上「流浪」、「雜種」、「低下」標籤的唐狗，在他的光影中，卻訴說著最純粹的忠誠與滄桑。有些被領養的唐狗年老患病，與領養家庭共度最後時光，蔡敏亮定格了他們最後的眼神交會、最後的告別——不是為了見證悲傷，而是為了見證每一個生命落幕時的尊嚴。. 人們無法留住時光的流逝，卻可以透過影像，為每一段愛的旅程留下痕跡。本片紀錄蔡敏亮自我療傷的過程中，用鏡頭展示出，唐狗也能被看見、被記得、成為被珍視的靈魂，更能為家庭帶來溫暖。牠們或許不起眼，卻改變著我們對愛、生死和陪伴的理解。他要用鏡頭在彩虹橋前為他們送上祝福、尊重及謝意.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 大自然奧秘
programme.desc: 地球約有二百萬個生物物種，昆蟲佔過半數，而且型態、能力各異，極富多樣性。箇中關鍵「完全變態」，更是昆蟲的「獨門秘技」，可以由幼蟲到成蟲，徹底改變形態、棲息地甚至攝食習性。本節目利用3D掃描影像，首次曝光蝶蛹蛻變的完整過程、分析蜜蜂的飛行技術；更會揭開寄生蟻群的古怪昆蟲神秘面紗。節目揭示昆蟲針對棲息地、天敵以至繁衍而作出的精密演化，以及昆蟲在維持地球生態所扮演的重要角色.

programme.title: 捨不得星星
programme.sub-title: 第二十八集：永恆的愛情
programme.desc: 深夜，周默默念着泰戈爾的詩，回憶着曾經和徐姍姍在一起的點點滴滴，顯得格外的落寞。壹休的金融業務審計臨近尾聲，馮蔚然與宋璟發生了衝突.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第八十六集 - 「好媽媽 別咆哮」
programme.desc: BobieLand 第八十六集-「好媽媽別咆哮」. 編導:蔡少傑. 子樂剛開學，已經多次遲到，更比老師約見家長。他擔心被媽媽責罰，BobieLand的朋友們各自獻計，最後園長澔天提出搞笑主意找人扮演子樂媽媽去見老師。究竟誰人是最適合人選⋯⋯. 【故事時間】「咆哮的媽媽」. 今個星期邀請到繪本中主角-圖媽媽和兒子圖圖親自和大家分享故事中母子二人的日常生活。. 故事有不少衝突，究竟誰是誰非？Okie Bobie與一眾小朋友能否化解圖媽媽與圖圖的衝突呢？. 【冷知識】. 園長Sarah姐姐發現「媽媽」一詞在世界各地不同語言系的發音都非常相似？何解呢？. Wheel 仔竟然知道答案.(n)

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師想送給賽思一個特別的飲料瓶，供她在遠足旅行時使用。從史前洞穴到現代海灘，尋古大師探索了這個容器的歷史。它曾被用來盛載各種液體，從水到飲料，甚至還有神奇的藥水。如今，飲料瓶已成為人們的“必需品”，人們可以隨時隨地解渴，無需使用一次性塑膠瓶.(n)

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師前往游泳池時，卻迷失在17世紀，他發現當時每個人都赤裸裸地沐浴，沒有人會感到尷尬！幾年後，情況卻截然相反：要游泳，就必須從頭到腳都穿好衣服！隨著時間的推移，尋古大師目睹了泳衣顛覆了社會傳統，逐漸縮小，最終只剩下一塊小小的布……然後，出人意料的是，在20世紀末，它再次覆蓋了全身….(n)

programme.sub-title: (A) 看不見的樂隊 (B) 緋緋最好的禮物

(B) 今天是爸爸的生日，緋緋想送他一份最棒的禮物，但她不知道送什麼好，她決定先由包禮物的花紙開始。可是當爸爸回到家裏時，她還是只預備了花紙。. . 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2020年10月18日 星期日 上午9時30分 (網上重溫) 至 2021年10月17日 星期日. (A) It's the day of the Pinkville Parade and the whole marching band has gotten sick! Luckily, Pinkalicious and her friends eagerly volunteer to perform in their stead. There's just one small problem…they don't have any instruments!. (B) It's Daddy's birthday and Pinkalicious wants to get him the most pinkatastic gift ever. She just doesn't know what that gift should be … she decides to start with the wrapping paper. But when Daddy gets home, that's all that's done. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2020.10.18 SUN 9:30am (Online Catch-up) Till 2021.10.17 Sun.(n)

programme.desc: BobieLand 第八十七集-「好媽媽別咆哮」. 編導:蔡少傑. 園長澔天哥哥邀約眾人來到BobieLand，為「子樂媽媽」挑選適合的人選，眾人出盡渾身解數扮演「子樂媽媽」，最終子樂發現Okie Bobie無論聲線和語氣都跟媽媽非常相似，於是決定由Okie Bobie 來扮演「子樂媽媽」⋯⋯. 【故事時間】「咆哮的媽媽」. 繪本中主角-圖媽媽和兒子圖圖繼續和大家分享故事中母子二人的日常生活。. 大家發現原來圖媽媽和兒子圖圖的衝突來自溝通不足，故事發展到最後，他們究竟能否和好如初呢？. 園長Kevin 哥哥教導圖圖製作一個小禮物送給圖媽媽哄她開心，可惜事與願違，圖圖又再一次激怒媽媽…….(n)

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.sub-title: #9 平凡卻有「營」的植物 – 薯仔
programme.desc: 今集請來小薯茄成員關浩傑(阿J)做嘉賓，廚師主持Andy Dark特地用「薯仔」準備了一道「冷盤」-椒絲腐乳薯仔沙律。阿J即場分享薯仔冷笑話之餘，亦坦言入行後更加注意鍛鍊身體，並請教心臟科專科高耀鈞醫生，如何備戰馬拉松。另外，原來薯仔是根莖類植物中比較「粗生易種」的，較短時間內就能有收成，識食專員就把握時機去農場了解如何「種薯得薯」。. 主持：黃婉曼(Icy)、Andy Dark. 嘉賓：關浩傑、高耀鈞醫生(心臟科專科).(n)

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 《港樂‧講樂 Pop Up》請來陳葦璇(Kira)和觀眾分享近況及舉辦個人音樂會時最難忘的場面，讓觀眾感受到她對生活與舞台的熱愛。現場演出方面，她帶來兩首作品——溫暖動人的《幸運兒》以及充滿動感的跳唱歌《Need You》，以歌聲傳遞力量與自信。嘉賓主持林沚羿(Venus)亦分享自己童星經歷及演唱代表作《Take a Break》。. 主持. 阮頌陽. 嘉賓主持. 林沚羿. 歌曲：. 《Take A Break》. 《幸運兒》. 《Need You.(n)

programme.sub-title: 第八十七集 - 「好媽媽 別咆哮」
programme.desc: BobieLand 第八十七集-「好媽媽別咆哮」. 編導:蔡少傑. 園長澔天哥哥邀約眾人來到BobieLand，為「子樂媽媽」挑選適合的人選，眾人出盡渾身解數扮演「子樂媽媽」，最終子樂發現Okie Bobie無論聲線和語氣都跟媽媽非常相似，於是決定由Okie Bobie 來扮演「子樂媽媽」⋯⋯. 【故事時間】「咆哮的媽媽」. 繪本中主角-圖媽媽和兒子圖圖繼續和大家分享故事中母子二人的日常生活。. 大家發現原來圖媽媽和兒子圖圖的衝突來自溝通不足，故事發展到最後，他們究竟能否和好如初呢？. 園長Kevin 哥哥教導圖圖製作一個小禮物送給圖媽媽哄她開心，可惜事與願違，圖圖又再一次激怒媽媽…….(n)

programme.sub-title: (A) 紅粉萬聖節 (B) 紅桑子稻草人
programme.desc: (A) 萬聖節前夕紅粉村因暴風雨令電力中斷，聯歡會更可能因而被取消，紅粉女俠及海盜王彼得決定出手挽救危機，令居民都能愉快過萬聖節。. (B) 緋緋、彼得、華仔及花花結伴去採摘紅莓，以炮製美味的紅莓奶昔，但卻發現紅莓差不多全被雀鳥吃掉。他們決定製作稻草人以趕走這群不速之客。. . 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2020年10月25日 星期日 上午9時30分 (網上重溫) 至 2021年10月24日 星期日. (A) A huge storm has knocked out Pinkville's power lines just days before Halloween! It looks like the holiday will be canceled - that is unless Pink-a-girl and Pirate Peter can find a way to save the day!. programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集：谷嶠懷疑抄襲事件是有人故意炒作
programme.desc: 袁歌和杜秉文約見爆料人賈龍，說準備終止和抄襲者的合作了，並且提出希望和賈龍的爺爺賈老建立合作，一同支持原創，卻遭到了賈龍的拒絕。杜秉文約谷嶠吃飯，其實是替袁歌和谷嶠創造機會見面。谷嶠看到是袁歌，立刻就要走。谷嶠被王美提醒，懷疑抄襲事件是有人故意炒作.(n)

programme.sub-title: 第二十三集：火車副司機眼睛不適差點出事故
programme.desc: 1984年春運，因車上擁堵，導致兩群人打架，汪新和馬魁靈活處理，眾人和解。馬魁肯定汪新的成長，只是師徒兩人已習慣互懟式交流。火車副司機老吳這些日子眼睛總是不舒服，各人前後勸說老吳治療，老吳依舊諱疾忌醫。因為老吳的眼睛疾病，差點出了工作事故.(n)

programme.title: 南來北往
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集：馬魁父女解開別扭
programme.desc: 新朋友賈金龍來大院拜訪汪新馬魁，偶遇姚玉玲。馬魁不在，汪新招呼賈金龍喝酒敘舊。馬燕回到家，發現馬魁為自己訂了想要的皮鞋，馬燕感動萬分。馬魁已然心知馬燕心裡的別扭緣由，又特地囑咐馬燕，自己對麗麗好，是因為當年彭明傑救過自己的命，自己得報恩.(n)

programme.desc: BobieLand 第八十八集-「好媽媽別咆哮」. 編導:蔡少傑. 為求「由Okie Bobie 扮演子樂媽媽代替見家長」的計畫順利進行，各園長與小朋友從髮型、化妝及服裝對Okie . Bobie進行大改造，令Okie Bobie形神兼備似足子樂媽媽。. 【More More魔術see】. programme.sub-title: 第三十集：有情人終成眷屬?
programme.desc: 半年後，匯商銀行、壹休好吃聯手和蘭溪古鎮達成了合作，致力於推動當地的傳統美食。200天紀念日，唐漾送給蔣時延薑餅味的香水，而蔣時延則送唐漾一對精緻的碗，兌現兩人當年許下的誓言.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 無極飛行
programme.sub-title: 無極飛行第四集：墨西哥 - 森林播種機
programme.desc: 墨西哥農民習慣焚燒田地，為下一季耕種作準備。火勢往往會升級，波及山上的樹林。 在恰帕斯州，每年就有二到三萬公頃的自然地帶被燒毀。 面對這個悲劇，被暱稱為「爺爺機長」的, José Camacho有個想法：利用他的小型飛機在被燒燬的土地上重新造林，加快大自然的修復過程…… 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年10月16日 星期一晚上10時30分 In Mexico there is an ancestral and devastating pastoral tradition… the burn. The peasants set fire to their fields to clean them in order to sow the next crops, often these fires escalate and spread to the wooded hills. Between 20 to 30,000 hectares of natural areas go up in smoke every year in Chiapas! Faced with this tragedy, José Camacho affectionately nicknamed El capitán, had this simple idea: to use his small plane to reforest the devastated lands and accelerate the natural process of reforestation. . Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.10.16 MON 10:30pm.(n)
